54	/** 锚腿判定（TileObject.cs:376-442 AnchorBottom 链 = U 批 chestLegOK 同构）：
55	 *  ①SolidTile（tileSolid&&!solidTop&&!noAttach&&!anchorInvalid）②平台 ③solidTop
56	 *  ④桌。★SolidTile 路须 blockType()==0（cs:388 `FlattenAnchors || blockType()==0`，
57	 *  chest FlattenAnchors=false）——半砖/坡腿不算实心锚。野外洞穴地形有大量半砖/坡
58	 *  （SmoothWorld 产物），曾漏检致 (755,695) 站坡腿上 vanilla 拒/JS 收的流分叉
59	 *  （2026-08-17 x86 AB 探针+hs54 half/slope 真值实锤）。 */
60	function chestLegOK(st: TileStore, lx: number, ly: number): boolean {
61	  if (!st.inBounds(lx, ly)) return false;
62	  const i = st.idx(lx, ly);
63	  if (!st.flags[i]) return false;                                   // nactive()=false
64	  const sheet = TILE_DEFS[st.type[i]]?.vanilla?.sheet ?? -1;
65	  const internal = st.type[i];
66	  const blockType0 = st.half[i] === 0 && st.slope[i] === 0;
67	  if (blockType0 && genSolidType(internal) && !PC_SOLID_TOP.has(sheet) && !PC_NO_ATTACH.has(sheet) && !PC_CHEST_ANCH_INVALID.has(sheet)) return true;
68	  if (PC_PLATFORMS.has(sheet)) return !PC_CHEST_ANCH_INVALID.has(sheet) && st.half[i] === 0;  // !halfBrick（properTopFrame 帧位不建模，备案）
69	  if (genSolidType(internal) && PC_SOLID_TOP.has(sheet)) return true;                          // solidTop 路（cs:402 无 blockType 门）
70	  if (PC_TILE_TABLE.has(sheet)) return blockType0;                   // Table 路（cs:407 blockType==0）
71	  return false;
72	}

132	/** Chest.NearOtherChests（Terraria/Chest.cs:524-538）1:1：[x-25,x+25) × [y-8,y+8)
133	 *  内已有 BasicChest{21,467} → true。本仓"已有箱"按 chest/dresser 键族近似
134	 *  （与 MicroBiomesPass isContainer/TileID.Sets.IsAContainer 同口径，含 467/88） */
135	function nearOtherChests(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number): boolean {
136	  for (let i = x - 25; i < x + 25; i++) {
137	    for (let j = y - 8; j < y + 8; j++) {
138	      if (!st.inBounds(i, j)) continue;   // Framing.GetTileSafely 界外 = 空格
139	      const k = st.idx(i, j);
140	      if (!st.flags[k]) continue;
141	      const key = TILE_DEFS[st.type[k]]?.key ?? '';
142	      if (key.includes('chest') || key.includes('dresser')) return true;
143	    }
144	  }
145	  return false;
146	}

150	  let result = [211, 212, 213, 964][gs.jungleItemIdx % 4];
151	  if (rng.int(0, 49) === 0) result = 753;       // 1/50 海草
152	  else if (rng.int(0, 14) === 0) result = 2292; // 1/15 玻璃钢鱼竿
153	  else if (rng.int(0, 19) === 0) result = 3017; // 1/20 花之靴
154	  gs.jungleItemIdx++;
155	  return result;
156	}

260	const __fr = Math.fround;
261	/** .NET Math.Round(float32 积, MidpointRounding.ToEven) == base（银行家舍入） */
262	function netRoundEq(base: number, mult: number): boolean {
263	  const v = __fr(__fr(base) * __fr(mult));   // (float)base * mult 在 float32 域
264	  const fl = Math.floor(v);
265	  const diff = v - fl;
266	  let r: number;
267	  if (diff > 0.5) r = fl + 1;
268	  else if (diff < 0.5) r = fl;
269	  else r = fl % 2 === 0 ? fl : fl + 1;       // 恰 .5 → 取偶
270	  return r === base;
271	}
272	/** Item.Prefix while 环四失败门（cs:546-550 → flag=true 重进环） */
273	function prefixTryGetFails(rolled: number, item: number): boolean {
274	  const s = PRE_STATS[item];
275	  if (!s) return false;                      // 配饰池（62-80）无乘子 → 恒通过
276	  const m = PRE_MULT[rolled];
277	  if (!m) return false;                      // 前缀无四项乘子 → 恒通过
278	  if (m[0] !== 1 && netRoundEq(s.d, m[0])) return true;
279	  if (m[2] !== 1 && netRoundEq(s.ua, m[2])) return true;
280	  if (m[3] !== 1 && netRoundEq(s.mana, m[3])) return true;
281	  if (m[1] !== 1 && s.kb0) return true;
282	  return false;
283	}

286	 *  → TryGet 四失败门失败则重进环（Next(4)+池再掷——GG 批残余①：地狱尾 3-4 掷） */

288	  const cls = PRE_CLASS[item];

578	      if (!items.some((it) => it && it.id === keyId)) items.unshift({ id: keyId, stack: 1 });
579	    }
580	  }
581	  return items;

584	/** AddBuriedChest（1456 cs:35920）下落/门禁段 1:1：
585	 *  自 j 向下扫至 k < maxTilesY-10，逐行检查 anyShimmer / 幼虫 231 → 整体失败；
586	 *  首个 SolidTile（半砖/坡面不算，WorldGen.SolidTile）落定。
587	 *  ±2 邻域（InWorld 100 边距）有 Boulders{138,484,664,665,711-716}/祭坛 26/蜥蜴祭坛 237 → 失败
588	 *  ——该检查在扫描循环内**逐行**执行（锚=当前行 k，cs:35992-36002），非仅起始行。
589	 *  notNearOtherChests:true 时经 Chest.NearOtherChests（±25×±8 已有箱）拒绝（cs:36253 透传）。
590	 *  样式/战利品解析与 2×2 放置沿用本仓库 rollChestLoot 管线。 */

592	  st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState, chests: ChestSink,
593	  i: number, j: number, opts: { style?: number; tile?: number; loot?: number | string; flags?: ChestFlags; trySlope?: boolean; notNearOtherChests?: boolean } = {},
594	): boolean {
595	  // 探针（AB/ABX 对拍 vanilla ChestProbe；无钩零开销）
596	  const __ab = (globalThis as { __swChestEv?: (p: string, i: number, j: number, x?: number) => void }).__swChestEv;
597	  const __n0 = (globalThis as { __swRollN?: number }).__swRollN ?? -1;
598	  __ab?.('ab', i, j, __n0);
599	  try {
600	    const r = placeBuriedChestInner(st, rng, gs, chests, i, j, opts);
601	    __ab?.('abx', i, j, r ? 1 : 0);
602	    return r;
603	  } catch (e) {
604	    __ab?.('abx', i, j, -1);
605	    throw e;
606	  }
607	}

609	function placeBuriedChestInner(
610	  st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState, chests: ChestSink,
611	  i: number, j: number, opts: { style?: number; tile?: number; loot?: number | string; flags?: ChestFlags; trySlope?: boolean; notNearOtherChests?: boolean } = {},
612	): boolean {
613	  // 下落到地面（cs:35931 `for k=j; k<maxTilesY-10; k++`）
614	  let gy = j;
615	  let slopeL = -1, slopeR = -1;   // trySlope 压平的坡度（失败时回填，cs:37567-37575）
616	  for (; gy < st.h - 10; gy++) {
617	    const k = st.idx(i, gy);
618	    if (st.liquid[k] > 0 && st.liquidType[k] === 4) return false;              // anyShimmer → 整体失败
619	    if (st.flags[k] && st.type[k] === LARVA) return false;                      // 幼虫 231 → 整体失败
620	    // ★±2 巨石/祭坛拒绝在扫描循环内**逐行**执行（cs:35992-36002，锚=当前行 k：
621	    //   InWorld(n,num6,100) && Boulders{138,484,664,665,711-716} || 26 || 237）。
622	    //   曾在进循环前以起始行 j 只查一次——起始行下方 2 格内的滚石/祭坛全部漏检
623	    for (let dx = -2; dx <= 2; dx++) {
624	      for (let dy = -2; dy <= 2; dy++) {
625	        const xx = i + dx, yy = gy + dy;
626	        if (xx < 100 || yy < 100 || xx >= st.w - 100 || yy >= st.h - 100) continue;
627	        const kk = st.idx(xx, yy);

635	      // 压平 (i-1,gy)/(i,gy) 的顶坡供放置（失败时回填）

639	            if (l < 5 || m < 5 || l >= st.w - 5 || m >= st.h - 5) return false;  // InWorld(l,m,5)

641	            if (st.flags[nk] && (st.type[nk] === CHEST || st.type[nk] === CHEST2)) return false;
642	          }
643	        }
644	      }
645	      if (opts.trySlope) {

648	          st.slope[st.idx(i - 1, gy)] = 0;
649	        }
650	        if (st.slope[k] >= 1 && st.slope[k] <= 2) {

652	          st.slope[k] = 0;
653	        }
654	      }
655	      break;
656	    }
657	  }
658	  if (gy >= st.h - 10) return false;

664	  };
665	
666	  let tile = opts.tile ?? CHEST;
667	  let style = opts.style;

675	  } else if (opts.loot !== undefined) {
676	    mainId = opts.loot;
677	  }

825	/** Buried Chests pass:L7907 洞穴段(CaveChestCount 35-40 × WorldArea/5040000)。
826	 *  ★地狱段拆出 runUnderworldChestsPass:本函数曾在 hellPass 之前执行,
827	 *  地狱箱被后续地狱地形重写 100% 抹除(实际 0 个) */
828	export function runBuriedChestsPass(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState, chests: ChestSink): void {
829	  const { w, h } = st;
830	  const yMin = Math.floor((gs.worldSurfaceHigh + 20 + gs.rockLevel) / 2);
831	  // 洞穴箱:35-40 × 面积缩放(Configuration.json CaveChestCount ScaleWith:WorldArea)。
832	  // ★WorldGenRange.GetRandom(WorldGenRange.cs:34-57):先缩放边界再 (int) 截断 →
833	  //   Next((int)(35s), (int)(40s)+1)。曾"先掷后乘+Math.round"(C10 同款旧公式)
834	  const target = gs.caveChestCount >= 0 ? gs.caveChestCount
835	    : rng.int(Math.trunc(35 * (w * h) / 5040000), Math.trunc(40 * (w * h) / 5040000));
836	  let fail = 10000;
837	  // cs:17112-17124 拒绝门：wallDungeon[wall] || wall==87 || oceanDepths(x,y)
838	  //   （oceanDepths = y ≤ oceanLevel(=(ws+rl)/2+40) 且 x<380 || x>w-380——尾批 2-C 补；
839	  //   曾漏致海带尝试多掷 1 次 AB，流分叉 @AB#69 (3826,490) 实证）
840	  const oceanLevel = (gs.worldSurface + gs.rockLevel) / 2 + 40;
841	  for (let n = 0; n < target && fail > 0; ) {
842	    const x = rng.int(20, w - 21);
843	    const y = rng.int(yMin, h - 231);
844	    const wl = st.inBounds(x, y) ? st.wall[st.idx(x, y)] : -1;
845	    // cs:17109：wallDungeon[wall] || wall == 87（神庙墙 87 独立门）→ 整体重掷
846	    if (isDungeonWall(wl) || wl === 87 || (y <= oceanLevel && (x < gs.beachDistance || x > w - gs.beachDistance))
847	      || !placeBuriedChest(st, rng, gs, chests, x, y)) {
848	      fail--; continue;
849	    }
850	    n++;
851	  }
852	}

854	/** 地狱箱(UnderworldChestCount 10-15 × WorldWidth/4200)。
855	 *  必须在 hellPass + 地狱屋之后调用(原版 Underworld(cs:13697) < Buried Chests(cs:17066)) */
856	export function runUnderworldChestsPass(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState, chests: ChestSink): void {
857	  const { w, h } = st;
858	  // gs 预掷优先(cs:17082 流位);回退公式同步 WorldGenRange 化(先缩放后截,
859	  // 曾 Math.round(rng.int(10,15)*(w/4200)) 旧式)
860	  const target = gs.underworldChestCount >= 0 ? gs.underworldChestCount
861	    : rng.int(Math.trunc(10 * (w / 4200)), Math.trunc(15 * (w / 4200)));
862	  let fail = 10000;
863	  for (let n = 0; n < target && fail > 0; ) {
864	    const x = rng.int(20, w - 21);
865	    const y = rng.int(h - 200, h - 51);
866	    // cs:17134-17140：wallDungeon[wall] → 整体重掷（无 wall==87/oceanDepths 门）
867	    const wl = st.inBounds(x, y) ? st.wall[st.idx(x, y)] : -1;
868	    if (isDungeonWall(wl) || !placeBuriedChest(st, rng, gs, chests, x, y)) {
869	      fail--; continue;
870	    }
871	    n++;
872	  }
873	}

875	/** Surface Chests pass(L8019):w*0.005 个地表木箱(style 0;墙 244 → 天空箱 style 12) */
876	export function runSurfaceChestsPass(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState, chests: ChestSink): void {
877	  const { w } = st;
878	  const count = Math.floor(w * 0.005);
879	  for (let n = 0; n < count; n++) {
880	    let ok = false;
881	    for (let tries = 0; tries < 2000 && !ok; tries++) {
882	      // cs:17244 首掷 Next(200, w-200);仅落点命中 oceanDepths(cs:17246-17254:
883	      // y ≤ oceanLevel=(ws+rl)/2+40 且 x 在海滩带内)才改掷 Next(300, w-300)——
884	      // 原版 WorldGen.beachDistance 是常量 380(cs:4102)
885	      let x = rng.int(200, w - 201);

225	}
226	
227	// ---------- 房内家具登记表（③ 清格击杀重验用）----------
228	interface HouseObj { x0: number; y0: number; w: number; h: number; kind: 'floor' | 'chand' }
229	/** 对象每格 → 对象元数据；placeHouse 头清空（对象生命周期=本屋） */
230	const houseObjCells = new Map<number, HouseObj>();
231	function regHouseObj(st: TileStore, x0: number, y0: number, w: number, h: number, kind: 'floor' | 'chand'): void {
232	  const obj: HouseObj = { x0, y0, w, h, kind };
233	  for (let dx = 0; dx < w; dx++) {
234	    for (let dy = 0; dy < h; dy++) {
235	      if (st.inBounds(x0 + dx, y0 + dy)) houseObjCells.set(st.idx(x0 + dx, y0 + dy), obj);
236	    }
237	  }
238	}
239	
240	/** SolidTileAllowBottomSlope（WorldGen.cs）：active && (tileSolid||tileSolidTop) && !half && 非顶坡 */
241	function supportOk(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number): boolean {
242	  if (!st.inBounds(x, y)) return true;              // 界外恒 true（原版 InWorld 早退）
243	  const i = st.idx(x, y);
244	  if (st.flags[i] === 0) return false;
245	  if (!vanGenSolidType(st.type[i]) && !HOUSE_SOLID_TOP.has(TILE_DEFS[st.type[i]]?.vanilla?.sheet ?? -1)) return false;
246	  if (st.half[i] !== 0) return false;
247	  if (st.slope[i] === 1 || st.slope[i] === 2) return false;  // 顶坡（平台正规顶帧例外略——房内地板无此形态）
248	  return true;
249	}
250	
251	/**
252	 * ③ ClearTile(frameNeighbors:true) 四邻重验（Check3x2/Check2xX/CheckChand/CheckPile 的
253	 * KillTile 段）：支承行任一格失实（floor 族）/顶锚失实（吊灯）→ 整件清除。worldgen 期
254	 * KillTile 零掷（house1 ③ 掷数精确含击杀实证）。级联 KillTile 的再邻接重验不建模
255	 * （vanilla Check 链在 destroyObject 门内同样短路）。
256	 */
257	function killUnsupportedFurniture(st: TileStore, cx: number, cy: number): void {
258	  if (!st.inBounds(cx, cy)) return;
259	  const i = st.idx(cx, cy);
260	  if (st.flags[i] === 0) return;
261	  const obj = houseObjCells.get(i);
262	  if (!obj) return;                                  // 非登记家具（画作/蛛网/主题块）各有别的 Check，不在本路径
263	  let dead = false;
264	  if (obj.kind === 'chand') {
265	    const ai = st.idx(obj.x0 + 1, obj.y0 - 1);       // CheckChand：顶锚 nactive && tileSolid && !solidTop
266	    dead = st.flags[ai] === 0 || !vanGenSolidType(st.type[ai]) || HOUSE_SOLID_TOP.has(TILE_DEFS[st.type[ai]]?.vanilla?.sheet ?? -1);
267	  } else {
268	    for (let k = obj.x0; k < obj.x0 + obj.w; k++) {
269	      if (!supportOk(st, k, obj.y0 + obj.h)) { dead = true; break; }
270	    }
271	  }
272	  if (!dead) return;
273	  for (let dx = 0; dx < obj.w; dx++) {
274	    for (let dy = 0; dy < obj.h; dy++) {
275	      const ci = st.idx(obj.x0 + dx, obj.y0 + dy);
276	      houseObjCells.delete(ci);
277	      st.setTileSilent(obj.x0 + dx, obj.y0 + dy, 0);
278	    }
279	  }
280	}
281	
282	/** WorldGen.PlaceTile 派发到各型放置器（FillRooms/cascadePlace 用到的型别全收） */
283	function placeFurniture(st: TileStore, key: string, x: number, y: number, style = 0, _anchor?: string): boolean {
284	  const t = TILE_BY_KEY[key];
285	  if (t === undefined) return false;
286	  const sheet = TILE_DEFS[t]?.vanilla?.sheet ?? -1;
287	  switch (sheet) {
288	    case 240: case 440: {           // Place3x3Wall(cs:44281)：(x-1,y-1) 3×3，style>35 行卷绕
289	      let s = style, row = 0;
290	      while (s > 35) { row++; s -= 36; }
291	      return placeWallArt(st, x - 1, y - 1, 3, 3, t, (dx) => s * 54 + dx * 18, (dy) => row * 54 + dy * 18);
292	    }
293	    case 245:                       // Place2x3Wall(cs:44595)：(x,y-1) 2×3
294	      return placeWallArt(st, x, y - 1, 2, 3, t, (dx) => style * 36 + dx * 18, (dy) => dy * 18);
295	    case 246:                       // Place3x2Wall(cs:44752)：(x-1,y) 3×2
296	      return placeWallArt(st, x - 1, y, 3, 2, t, (dx) => dx * 18, (dy) => style * 36 + dy * 18);
297	    case 241:                       // Place4x3Wall(cs:44874)：(x-1,y-1) 4×3
298	      return placeWallArt(st, x - 1, y - 1, 4, 3, t, (dx) => style * 54 + dx * 18, (dy) => dy * 18);
299	    case 242:                       // Place6x4Wall(cs:44959)：(x-2,y-2) 6×4
300	      return placeWallArt(st, x - 2, y - 2, 6, 4, t, (dx) => (style % 27) * 72 + dx * 18, (dy) => Math.floor(style / 27) * 108 + dy * 18);
301	    case 34: {                      // PlaceChand(cs:52753)：(x-1,y) 3×3 吊挂；门=九格 !active
302	      //   + (x,y-1) nactive && tileSolid && !tileSolidTop——【无下方承地门】(吊灯
303	      //   悬顶),曾误走 placeFloorObject 的 below 检查 → 房内吊灯全灭(room1 实锤)
304	      if (!st.inBounds(x, y - 1) || !solid2(st, x, y - 1) || HOUSE_SOLID_TOP.has(sheetOf(st, x, y - 1))) return false;
305	      for (let dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) {
306	        for (let dy = 0; dy < 3; dy++) {
307	          if (!st.inBounds(x + dx, y + dy) || st.flags[st.idx(x + dx, y + dy)] !== 0) return false;
308	        }
309	      }
310	      for (let dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) {
311	        for (let dy = 0; dy < 3; dy++) {
312	          st.setTileSilent(x + dx, y + dy, t, Math.floor(style / 36) * 108 + (dx + 1) * 18, style * 54 + dy * 18);
313	        }
314	      }
315	      regHouseObj(st, x - 1, y, 3, 3, 'chand');
316	      return true;
317	    }
318	    case 14: case 26: case 86: case 87: case 88: case 89: case 114: case 187: case 215: case 217: case 218:
319	    case 377: case 469:             // Place3x2(cs:52097)：(x-1,y-1) 3×2，下方逐列 SolidTile2
320	      return placeFloorObject(st, x - 1, y - 1, 3, 2, t, (dx) => style * 54 + dx * 18, (dy) => dy * 18);
321	    case 186:                       // Place3x2 + InvalidTileForPilesOrSpeleothems（拒 Boulders 垫）
322	      return placeFloorObject(st, x - 1, y - 1, 3, 2, t, (dx) => style * 54 + dx * 18, (dy) => dy * 18, true);
323	    case 16: case 18: case 29: case 103: case 134: case 462:   // Place2x1(cs:47371)：(x,y) 2×1
324	      return placeFloorObject(st, x, y, 2, 1, t, (dx) => style * 36 + dx * 18, () => 0);
325	    case 94: case 95: case 97: case 98: case 99: case 100: case 125: case 126: case 172: case 173:
326	    case 287: case 751: case 752:   // Place2x2(cs:51352)：(x-1,y-1) 2×2（94 keg 在此）
327	      return placeFloorObject(st, x - 1, y - 1, 2, 2, t, (dx) => style * 36 + dx * 18, (dy) => dy * 18);
328	    case 101:                       // Place3x4(cs:51943)：(x-1,y-3) 3×4 + SquareTileFrame（零掷）
329	      return placeFloorObject(st, x - 1, y - 3, 3, 4, t, (dx) => style * 54 + dx * 18, (dy) => dy * 18);
330	    case 219:                       // case106 族 Place3x3(cs:53549 num=-2 段)：(x-1,y-2) 3×3
331	      return placeFloorObject(st, x - 1, y - 2, 3, 3, t, (dx) => style * 54 + dx * 18, (dy) => dy * 18);
332	    case 506:                       // Place2xX(case 104 族)：(x,y-2) 2×3
333	      return placeFloorObject(st, x, y - 2, 2, 3, t, (dx) => style * 36 + dx * 18, (dy) => dy * 18);
334	    default:
335	      return false;                 // 未收录型别保守拒绝（勿静默错位）
336	  }
337	}

339	/** 雕像(2×3,style*36 步长);STATUES_WITH_TRAPS 命中 → 邻近飞镖陷阱+接线 */
340	function placeStatue(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number, idx: number): boolean {
341	  const [sheet, style] = STATUE_LIST[idx];
342	  const tile = sheet === 349 ? STATUE_349 : STATUE_105;
343	  if (!tile || !st.inBounds(x + 1, y - 2)) return false;
344	  // Place2xX 前置(cs:39755)：下方双格 SolidTile2（旧缺此门）
345	  if (!solid2(st, x, y + 1) || !solid2(st, x + 1, y + 1)) return false;
346	  for (let dx = 0; dx < 2; dx++) {
347	    for (let dy = -2; dy <= 0; dy++) {
348	      if (st.flags[st.idx(x + dx, y + dy)]) return false;
349	    }
350	  }
351	  // 雕像帧换行（Place2xX case 105，cs:39716-39720）：每行 55 列——
352	  // frameX=(style%55)*36、frameY=floor(style/55)*54（与 StatuesPass 同实现；
353	  // 此前单轴 style*36，style≥55 越界错位）
354	  const row = Math.floor(style / 55);
355	  for (let dx = 0; dx < 2; dx++) {
356	    for (let dy = 0; dy < 3; dy++) {
357	      st.setTileSilent(x + dx, y - 2 + dy, tile, (style - row * 55) * 36 + dx * 18, row * 54 + dy * 18);
358	    }
359	  }
360	  regHouseObj(st, x, y - 2, 2, 3, 'floor');
361	  if (STATUES_WITH_TRAPS.has(idx)) placeStatueTrap(st, x, y);
362	  return true;
363	}

365	// ---------- 画(RandHousePicture cs:35336 / Desert cs:35286) ----------
366	const PIC_240 = [26, 28, 20, 21, 22, 24, 25, 33, 34, 35, 76, 77, 78, 79, 82, 96, 98, 100];
367	const PIC_245 = [0, 3, 5, 6, 14, -1, 19, 20, 21]; // -1 → 15+rng(4)
368	const PIC_246 = [1, 30, 31, 32, 33, 34, 35, 36];
369	function randHousePicture(rng: RNG): [string, number] {
370	  let n = rng.int(0, 3);
371	  if (n >= 3 && rng.int(0, 1) !== 0) n = rng.int(0, 2);
372	  if (n <= 1) return ['v_240_wall_hangings_3x3', PIC_240[rng.int(0, 17)]];
373	  if (n === 2) {
374	    let s = rng.int(0, 8);
375	    if (s === 0 && rng.int(0, 2) !== 0) s = rng.int(0, 8);
376	    const style = s === 5 ? 15 + rng.int(0, 3) : PIC_245[s];
377	    return ['v_245_paintings_2x3', style];
378	  }
379	  return ['v_246_paintings_3x2', PIC_246[rng.int(0, 7)]];
380	}
381	function randHousePictureDesert(rng: RNG): [string, number] {
382	  const n = rng.int(0, 3);
383	  if (n <= 1) return ['v_240_wall_hangings_3x3', [63, 64, 65, 66, 67, 68][rng.int(0, 5)]];
384	  if (n === 2) return ['v_245_paintings_2x3', 7 + rng.int(0, 1)];
385	  return ['v_242_paintings_6x4', 37 + rng.int(0, 5)];
386	}

388	// ---------- 原版 GenAction 链 1:1 解释器(Modifiers.cs / Actions.cs 逐条核实) ----------
389	// 三条权威语义(旧实现全部踩错,修复根因):
390	//  · Dither(p)(Modifiers.cs:621-635):p 是【失败率】——NextDouble() >= p 才放行,
391	//    即 Dither(0.85) 通过率仅 15%。旧实现把 0.85 当通过率(< 0.85 即过),七主题
392	//    蚀变量级整体取反(C1)。
393	//  · Blotches(Modifiers.cs:92-152,Apply :131-152):每点【先丢 1 掷】,再
394	//    NextDouble() < chance 决定是否成斑;成斑再掷 4 次(Next(1-minX,1)/Next(0,maxX)/
395	//    Next(1-minY,1)/Next(0,maxY))并把后续链应用到随机矩形(会外溢房外);未成斑
396	//    则原点继续。旧实现用自制哈希值噪声替斑,分布与掷骰数都不对(C2)。
397	//  · 链序 = 掷骰序:Dither/Blotches 永远排在 OnlyTiles/OnlyWalls 之前
398	//    (各 *HouseBuilder.cs AgeRoom),对房间矩形内每格都掷,失败短路后不耗 RNG(C3);
399	//    墙动作的 worldSurface 二选一按【房间】room.Y 判定(WoodHouseBuilder.cs:36 /
400	//    IceHouseBuilder.cs:32),非逐格。
401	type ChainStep =
402	  | { k: 'dither'; p: number }                                            // Modifiers.Dither
403	  | { k: 'blotches'; minX: number; maxX: number; minY: number; maxY: number; chance: number } // Modifiers.Blotches
404	  | { k: 'onlyTiles'; types: number[] }                                   // Modifiers.OnlyTiles(Modifiers.cs:238)
405	  | { k: 'onlyWalls'; types: number[] }                                   // Modifiers.OnlyWalls(Modifiers.cs:216)
406	  | { k: 'skipTiles'; types: number[] }                                   // Modifiers.SkipTiles(Modifiers.cs:392)
407	  | { k: 'isEmpty' }                                                      // Modifiers.IsEmpty(Modifiers.cs:539)
408	  | { k: 'offset'; dx: number; dy: number }                               // Modifiers.Offset(Modifiers.cs:603)
409	  | { k: 'setTileKeepWall'; tile: number }                                // Actions.SetTileKeepWall(Actions.cs:272)
410	  | { k: 'setTile'; tile: number }                                        // Actions.SetTile(Actions.cs:203)
411	  | { k: 'clearTile' }                                                    // Actions.ClearTile(Actions.cs:155)
412	  | { k: 'clearWall'; frame?: boolean }                                   // Actions.ClearWall(Actions.cs:171；frame=true → 四邻 SquareWallFrame 掷)
413	  | { k: 'placeWall'; wall: number }                                      // Actions.PlaceWall(Actions.cs:516)
414	  | { k: 'stalagtite' }                                                   // ActionStalagtite → WorldGen.PlaceTight
415	  | { k: 'vines'; min: number; max: number; vine: number };               // ActionVines
416	
417	// ---------- 墙重帧掷（尾批 2-C ★房屋链欠掷 5 万主根因）----------
418	// Actions.PlaceWall/ClearWall(frameNeighbors:true) → WorldGen.SquareWallFrame(x,y)
419	// 【resetFrame:true 默认】→ Framing.WallFrame 中心格掷 Next(0,3)（Framing.cs:388-397，
420	// wallFrameNumber 重置）；墙 21 命中再掷 Next(2)。SquareWallFrame 本体对 8 邻格用
421	// resetFrame:false（零掷）。豁免：wall==0（早退）/wallLargeFrames∈{1,2}（查表分支
422	// 零掷——Main.cs:9652+ 全表 {224,323-330,179,146,147,167,185,274,354,355,358,359,
423	// 362,363,366}）。PlaceWall.Apply 序（Actions.cs:528-538）：置墙 → SquareWallFrame(x,y)
424	// → (x+1,y)/(x-1,y)/(x,y-1)/(x,y+1) 四邻（各中心格按彼时墙值判定掷否）。
425	// ClearWall(true) 同四邻序、无自格（WorldUtils.cs:67-76）。
426	const WALL_LARGE_FRAMES = new Set([224, 323, 324, 325, 326, 327, 328, 329, 330, 179, 146, 147, 167, 185, 274, 354, 355, 358, 359, 362, 363, 366]);
427	/** SquareWallFrame(x,y,resetFrame=true) 的中心格掷骰语义（结果不入墙帧——仅保流） */
428	function wallFrameResetRoll(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, x: number, y: number): void {
429	  if (x <= 0 || y <= 0 || x >= st.w - 1 || y >= st.h - 1) return;  // Framing.WallFrame 边界早退
430	  const w = st.wall[st.idx(x, y)];
431	  if (w === 0) return;                    // 墙 0 → 无掷
432	  if (WALL_LARGE_FRAMES.has(w)) return;   // 大帧墙查表分支 → 无掷
433	  rng.int(0, 2);                          // num2 = Next(0,3)
434	  if (w === 21) rng.int(0, 1);            // 墙 21 花墙 → Next(2)
435	}
436	/** Actions.PlaceWall（neighbors=true 恒真）逐格掷序 */
437	function placeWallRolled(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, x: number, y: number, wall: number): void {
438	  st.setWallSilent(x, y, wall);
439	  wallFrameResetRoll(st, rng, x, y);
440	  wallFrameResetRoll(st, rng, x + 1, y);
441	  wallFrameResetRoll(st, rng, x - 1, y);
442	  wallFrameResetRoll(st, rng, x, y - 1);
443	  wallFrameResetRoll(st, rng, x, y + 1);
444	}
445	
446	/** GenAction.Apply 第 i 步 @ (x,y),失败短路返回 false(不执行后续步骤、不耗 RNG) */
447	function applyChain(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, steps: ChainStep[], i: number, x: number, y: number): boolean {
448	  if (i >= steps.length) return true;
449	  const s = steps[i];
450	  switch (s.k) {
451	    case 'dither':
452	      // Modifiers.cs:630-635:NextDouble() >= _failureChance 才 UnitApply
453	      return rng.next() >= s.p && applyChain(st, rng, steps, i + 1, x, y);
454	    case 'blotches': {
455	      rng.next();                                                    // 丢 1 掷(Modifiers.cs:132)
456	      if (rng.next() < s.chance) {                                   // 成斑判定(:133)
457	        const x0 = rng.int(1 - s.minX, 0);                           // Next(1-minX, 1)(:136)
458	        const x1 = rng.int(0, s.maxX - 1);                           // Next(0, maxX)(:137)
459	        const y0 = rng.int(1 - s.minY, 0);                           // Next(1-minY, 1)(:138)
460	        const y1 = rng.int(0, s.maxY - 1);                           // Next(0, maxY)(:139)
461	        let ok = true;                                               // flag |= !UnitApply(:140-145)
462	        for (let dx = x0; dx <= x1; dx++) {
463	          for (let dy = y0; dy <= y1; dy++) {
464	            if (!applyChain(st, rng, steps, i + 1, x + dx, y + dy)) ok = false;
465	          }
466	        }
467	        return ok;
468	      }
469	      return applyChain(st, rng, steps, i + 1, x, y);                // 未成斑原点继续(:148)
470	    }
471	    case 'onlyTiles': {
472	      if (!activeAt(st, x, y)) return false;                         // !active → Fail(:245)
473	      const t = st.type[st.idx(x, y)];
474	      return s.types.includes(t) && applyChain(st, rng, steps, i + 1, x, y);
475	    }
476	    case 'onlyWalls':
477	      // Blotches 扇出可外溢房外 1 格,读前兜底(房间本体 InWorld 10 边距本已安全)
478	      return st.inBounds(x, y) && s.types.includes(st.wall[st.idx(x, y)])
479	        && applyChain(st, rng, steps, i + 1, x, y);
480	    case 'skipTiles': {
481	      if (!activeAt(st, x, y)) return applyChain(st, rng, steps, i + 1, x, y); // !active 放行(:399)
482	      return !s.types.includes(st.type[st.idx(x, y)]) && applyChain(st, rng, steps, i + 1, x, y);
483	    }
484	    case 'isEmpty':
485	      return !activeAt(st, x, y) && applyChain(st, rng, steps, i + 1, x, y);
486	    case 'offset':
487	      return applyChain(st, rng, steps, i + 1, x + s.dx, y + s.dy);
488	    case 'setTileKeepWall':
489	      // Actions.cs:272-301:存墙→Clear(~(Wiring|Actuator))【液体/坡度/半砖/块漆全清】→
490	      //   写 type+active→还原墙(+墙帧)。setTileSilent 不清液体/坡度——两处补齐
491	      //   （坡度残留曾致 house27 (1210,957) 腿 slope=2 拒箱,vanilla 落 957 成箱）。
492	      if (st.inBounds(x, y)) {
493	        const ci = st.idx(x, y);
494	        st.liquid[ci] = 0;
495	        st.liquidType[ci] = 0;
496	        st.slope[ci] = 0;
497	        st.half[ci] = 0;
498	      }
499	      st.setTileSilent(x, y, s.tile);
500	      return applyChain(st, rng, steps, i + 1, x, y);
501	    case 'setTile':
502	      // Actions.cs:203-218:setSelfFrames 之外的默认 clearTile=true →
503	      //   tile.Clear(~(Wiring|Actuator)) —— Tile.cs Clear 掩码含 Wall/WallPaint/
504	      //   Liquid(含 liquidType)/Slope：置块同时【把墙清 0】。木屋①蛛网 SetTile(51)/
505	      //   蘑菇② SetTile(71) 因此把内腔墙抹掉 → 后续②墙链 OnlyWalls(WallType) 在
506	      //   这些格 Fail 不掷——曾漏此语义（setTileSilent 不动墙）致 ② 过掷
507	      //   （house0 ② vanilla 215 vs JS 238，AB#558 段实测）。
508	      if (st.inBounds(x, y)) {
509	        const ci = st.idx(x, y);
510	        st.wall[ci] = 0;
511	        st.liquid[ci] = 0;
512	        st.liquidType[ci] = 0;
513	        st.slope[ci] = 0;
514	        st.half[ci] = 0;
515	      }
516	      st.setTileSilent(x, y, s.tile);
517	      return applyChain(st, rng, steps, i + 1, x, y);
518	    case 'clearTile':
519	      st.setTileSilent(x, y, 0);
520	      // ★ClearTile(frameNeighbors:true)（木屋③专属路径）→ 四邻 WorldGen.TileFrame →
521	      //   TileFrameImportant → Check3x2/Check2xX/CheckChand… 重验支承：支承行任一格
522	      //   （或吊灯顶锚）已失实 → destroyObject+KillTile 整件（Check3x2 cs KillTile 段）
523	      //   ——worldgen 期 KillTile 零掷（house1 ③ 120 掷精确含四件击杀实锤）。不建模则
524	      //   家具滞留 → 箱级联占位失败流漂（house1 钢琴占 (2037..2039,353) 挡 vanilla 箱
525	      //   (2038,355) 的 AB#560 首异实锤）。
526	      killUnsupportedFurniture(st, x + 1, y);
527	      killUnsupportedFurniture(st, x - 1, y);
528	      killUnsupportedFurniture(st, x, y - 1);
529	      killUnsupportedFurniture(st, x, y + 1);
530	      return applyChain(st, rng, steps, i + 1, x, y);
531	    case 'clearWall':
532	      // WorldUtils.ClearWall(x,y,frame)：清墙后 frame=true 时四邻 SquareWallFrame
533	      // （中心格掷——尾批 2-C 墙重帧掷模型）；frame 缺省 false（蘑菇 ③）零掷
534	      st.setWallSilent(x, y, 0);
535	      if (s.frame) {
536	        wallFrameResetRoll(st, rng, x + 1, y);
537	        wallFrameResetRoll(st, rng, x - 1, y);
538	        wallFrameResetRoll(st, rng, x, y - 1);
539	        wallFrameResetRoll(st, rng, x, y + 1);
540	      }
541	      return applyChain(st, rng, steps, i + 1, x, y);
542	    case 'placeWall':
543	      placeWallRolled(st, rng, x, y, s.wall);
544	      return applyChain(st, rng, steps, i + 1, x, y);
545	    case 'stalagtite':
546	      placeTight(st, rng, x, y);                                     // ActionStalagtite 恒 UnitApply
547	      return applyChain(st, rng, steps, i + 1, x, y);
548	    case 'vines': {
549	      // ActionVines.cs:21-35:len=Next(min,max+1);逐格向下铺到实心;i>0 才算成功
550	      const len = rng.int(s.min, s.max);
551	      let placed = 0;
552	      for (let k = 0; k < len && st.inBounds(x, y + k) && !activeAt(st, x, y + k); k++) {
553	        st.setTileSilent(x, y + k, s.vine, 0, 0);
554	        placed++;
555	      }
556	      return placed > 0 && applyChain(st, rng, steps, i + 1, x, y);
557	    }
558	  }
559	}

561	/** WorldUtils.Gen + Shapes.Rectangle(Shapes.cs Rectangle.Perform):x 外层 / y 内层 */
562	function genRect(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, steps: ChainStep[], ox: number, oy: number, w: number, h: number): void {
563	  const __g = (globalThis as { __swAgeGen?: (o: number, x: number, y: number, w: number, h: number, k: number) => void }).__swAgeGen;
564	  const __rn = () => (globalThis as { __swRollN?: number }).__swRollN ?? -1;
565	  __g?.(__rn(), ox, oy, w, h, steps[0]?.k === 'dither' && steps[1]?.k === 'blotches' ? 1 : 0);
566	  for (let x = ox; x < ox + w; x++) {
567	    for (let y = oy; oy + h > y; y++) applyChain(st, rng, steps, 0, x, y);
568	  }
569	  __g?.(__rn(), ox, oy, w, h, -1);
570	}

572	// ---------- 钟乳石(WorldGen.PlaceTight 1:1) ----------
573	/** PlaceUncheckedStalactite 的冰分支(cs:38377-38405):上方 ∈{147,161,163,164,200}
574	 *  才放置;其余名单(石/苔/沙等)在地下屋场景上方是主题块,恒静默返回 */
575	function placeUncheckedStalactite(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number, preferSmall: boolean, variation: number): void {
576	  if (!solidAt(st, x, y - 1) || activeAt(st, x, y) || activeAt(st, x, y + 1)) return;
577	  const above = st.type[st.idx(x, y - 1)];
578	  if (above !== SNOW147 && above !== ICE161
579	    && above !== TILE_BY_KEY['v_163_purple_ice_block']! && above !== sheetTile(164)
580	    && above !== TILE_BY_KEY['v_200_red_ice_block']!) return;
581	  // 冰族专属列（GetDesiredStalagtiteStyle :38800-38808 重定型）：147/161→0、
582	  // 163→594、164→540、200→648——曾全写 fx0 冰柱列（163/164/200 错列）
583	  const base = above === SNOW147 || above === ICE161 ? 0
584	    : above === TILE_BY_KEY['v_163_purple_ice_block']! ? 594
585	    : above === sheetTile(164) ? 540 : 648;
586	  if (preferSmall) {
587	    st.setTileSilent(x, y, STALACTITE, base + variation * 18, 72);
588	  } else {
589	    st.setTileSilent(x, y, STALACTITE, base + variation * 18, 0);
590	    st.setTileSilent(x, y + 1, STALACTITE, base + variation * 18, 18);
591	  }
592	}
593	
594	/** WorldGen.PlaceTight(cs:38329-38351):231 幼虫(及 shimmer,生成期无来源)短路,
595	 *  其余【恒先掷 2 次】Next(2)/Next(3) 再走 PlaceUncheckedStalactite——名单外静默
596	 *  返回但掷骰照耗(沙漠/花岗岩/大理石的 ActionStalagtite 行因此也要走这里) */
597	function placeTight(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, x: number, y: number): void {
598	  if (!st.inBounds(x, y)) return;
599	  const i = st.idx(x, y);
600	  if (st.flags[i] !== 0 && st.type[i] === LARVA231) return;
601	  const preferSmall = rng.int(0, 1) === 0;
602	  const variation = rng.int(0, 2);
603	  placeUncheckedStalactite(st, x, y, preferSmall, variation);
604	}

606	/** AgeRoom 七主题蚀变:逐主题把原版 WorldUtils.Gen 链逐条转录(行号 = 各
607	 *  *HouseBuilder.cs AgeRoom)。Dither/Blotches 语义见 applyChain 头注(C1/C2/C3) */
608	function ageRoom(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState, r: Rect, theme: Theme, def: ThemeDef): void {
609	  // Blotches(scale=2)→ minX=maxX=minY=maxY=2(Modifiers.cs:95-100)
610	  const B2 = (chance: number): ChainStep => ({ k: 'blotches', minX: 2, maxX: 2, minY: 2, maxY: 2, chance });
611	  // 墙段收尾:room.Y > worldSurface 时清墙、否则铺墙——按【房间】整体二选一
612	  // (WoodHouseBuilder.cs:36 / IceHouseBuilder.cs:32 的三元表达式在链构造时求值)
613	  const wallTail = (surfaceWall: number): ChainStep[] => [
614	    { k: 'skipTiles', types: SKIP_AGING_TILES },
615	    r.y > gs.worldSurface ? { k: 'clearWall', frame: true } : { k: 'placeWall', wall: surfaceWall },
616	  ];
617	
618	  if (theme === 'wood') {
619	    // ① 蛛网(WoodHouseBuilder.cs:30-35):W*H/16 次,每处 2×2 矩形跑
620	    //   Dither(0.5)+Blotches(2,2,chance 0.3)+IsEmpty+SetTile(51)
621	    const count = Math.floor(r.w * r.h / 16);
622	    for (let c = 0; c < count; c++) {
623	      const x = rng.int(1, r.w - 2) + r.x;
624	      const y = rng.int(1, r.h - 2) + r.y;
625	      genRect(st, rng, [{ k: 'dither', p: 0.5 }, B2(0.3), { k: 'isEmpty' }, { k: 'setTile', tile: COBWEB }], x, y, 2, 2);
626	    }
627	    // ② 墙侵蚀(WoodHouseBuilder.cs:36):Dither(0.85)+Blotches()+OnlyWalls(27)+
628	    //   SkipTiles(画族)+清墙/铺土墙 2
629	    genRect(st, rng, [
630	      { k: 'dither', p: 0.85 }, B2(0.3), { k: 'onlyWalls', types: [def.wall] }, ...wallTail(2),
631	    ], r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h);
632	    // ③ 第三段(WoodHouseBuilder.cs:37,曾整体缺失 C4):Dither(0.95)+
633	    //    OnlyTiles(30,321,158)+ClearTile——剥掉木/针叶/红木主题块
634	    genRect(st, rng, [
635	      { k: 'dither', p: 0.95 },
636	      { k: 'onlyTiles', types: [T.WOOD, TILE_BY_KEY['v_321_boreal_wood']!, TILE_BY_KEY['v_158_rich_mahogany']!] },
637	      { k: 'clearTile' },
638	    ], r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h);
639	    return;
640	  }
641	  if (theme === 'ice') {
642	    // ① 321→161→147(IceHouseBuilder.cs:29):Dither(0.6)+Blotches(2,0.6)+
643	    //   OnlyTiles(321)+SetTileKeepWall(161)+Dither(0.8)+SetTileKeepWall(147)
644	    genRect(st, rng, [
645	      { k: 'dither', p: 0.6 }, B2(0.6), { k: 'onlyTiles', types: [def.tile] },
646	      { k: 'setTileKeepWall', tile: ICE161 },
647	      { k: 'dither', p: 0.8 }, { k: 'setTileKeepWall', tile: SNOW147 },
648	    ], r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h);
649	    // ② 顶/底行钟乳石(IceHouseBuilder.cs:30-31):Dither(0.5)+OnlyTiles(161)+
650	    //   Offset(0,1)+ActionStalagtite,矩形 (X+1, 行, W-2, 1)
651	    for (const rowY of [r.y, r.y + r.h - 1]) {
652	      genRect(st, rng, [
653	        { k: 'dither', p: 0.5 }, { k: 'onlyTiles', types: [ICE161] }, { k: 'offset', dx: 0, dy: 1 }, { k: 'stalagtite' },
654	      ], r.x + 1, rowY, r.w - 2, 1);
655	    }
656	    // ③ 墙(IceHouseBuilder.cs:32,无 OnlyWalls):Dither(0.85)+Blotches(2,0.8)+
657	    //   SkipTiles(画族)+清墙/铺墙 40
658	    genRect(st, rng, [{ k: 'dither', p: 0.85 }, B2(0.8), ...wallTail(40)], r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h);
659	    return;
660	  }
661	  if (theme === 'jungle') {
662	    // ① 158→60→59(JungleHouseBuilder.cs:29):Dither(0.6)+Blotches(2,0.6)+
663	    //   OnlyTiles(158)+SetTileKeepWall(60)+Dither(0.8)+SetTileKeepWall(59)
664	    genRect(st, rng, [
665	      { k: 'dither', p: 0.6 }, B2(0.6), { k: 'onlyTiles', types: [def.tile] },
666	      { k: 'setTileKeepWall', tile: JUNGLE60 },
667	      { k: 'dither', p: 0.8 }, { k: 'setTileKeepWall', tile: MUD59 },
668	    ], r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h);
669	    // ② 藤(JungleHouseBuilder.cs:30-31):Dither(0.5)+OnlyTiles(60)+Offset(0,1)+
670	    //   IsEmpty+ActionVines(3, H, 62)
671	    for (const rowY of [r.y, r.y + r.h - 1]) {
672	      genRect(st, rng, [
673	        { k: 'dither', p: 0.5 }, { k: 'onlyTiles', types: [JUNGLE60] }, { k: 'offset', dx: 0, dy: 1 },
674	        { k: 'isEmpty' }, { k: 'vines', min: 3, max: r.h, vine: VINE62 },
675	      ], r.x + 1, rowY, r.w - 2, 1);
676	    }
677	    // ③ 墙 64(JungleHouseBuilder.cs:32,无 OnlyWalls/SkipTiles)
678	    genRect(st, rng, [{ k: 'dither', p: 0.85 }, B2(0.3), { k: 'placeWall', wall: 64 }], r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h);
679	    return;
680	  }
681	  if (theme === 'mushroom') {
682	    // ① 190→70(MushroomHouseBuilder.cs:27):Dither(0.7)+Blotches(2,0.5)+OnlyTiles(190)
683	    genRect(st, rng, [
684	      { k: 'dither', p: 0.7 }, B2(0.5), { k: 'onlyTiles', types: [def.tile] },
685	      { k: 'setTileKeepWall', tile: MUSH70 },
686	    ], r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h);
687	    // ② 顶/底行(MushroomHouseBuilder.cs:28-29):Dither(0.6)+OnlyTiles(70)+
688	    //   Offset(0,-1)+IsEmpty+SetTile(71)
689	    for (const rowY of [r.y, r.y + r.h - 1]) {
690	      genRect(st, rng, [
691	        { k: 'dither', p: 0.6 }, { k: 'onlyTiles', types: [MUSH70] }, { k: 'offset', dx: 0, dy: -1 },
692	        { k: 'isEmpty' }, { k: 'setTile', tile: SHROOM71 },
693	      ], r.x + 1, rowY, r.w - 2, 1);
694	    }
695	    // ③ 墙清空(MushroomHouseBuilder.cs:30)
696	    genRect(st, rng, [{ k: 'dither', p: 0.85 }, B2(0.3), { k: 'clearWall' }], r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h);
697	    return;
698	  }
699	  if (theme === 'granite' || theme === 'marble') {
700	    // ① 369→368 / 357→367(GraniteHouseBuilder.cs:28 / MarbleHouseBuilder.cs:28):
701	    //   Dither(0.6)+Blotches(2,0.6)+OnlyTiles(主题块)+SetTileKeepWall(368/367)
702	    const to = theme === 'granite' ? GRANITE368 : MARBLE367;
703	    genRect(st, rng, [
704	      { k: 'dither', p: 0.6 }, B2(0.6), { k: 'onlyTiles', types: [def.tile] },
705	      { k: 'setTileKeepWall', tile: to },
706	    ], r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h);
707	    // ② 顶/底行(GraniteHouseBuilder.cs:29-30):Dither(0.8)+OnlyTiles(368/367)+
708	    //   Offset(0,1)+ActionStalagtite(名单外 no-op,但 Dither/PlaceTight 掷骰照耗)
709	    for (const rowY of [r.y, r.y + r.h - 1]) {
710	      genRect(st, rng, [
711	        { k: 'dither', p: 0.8 }, { k: 'onlyTiles', types: [to] }, { k: 'offset', dx: 0, dy: 1 }, { k: 'stalagtite' },
712	      ], r.x + 1, rowY, r.w - 2, 1);
713	    }
714	    // ③ 墙 180/178(GraniteHouseBuilder.cs:31 / MarbleHouseBuilder.cs:31)
715	    genRect(st, rng, [
716	      { k: 'dither', p: 0.85 }, B2(0.3), { k: 'placeWall', wall: theme === 'granite' ? 180 : 178 },
717	    ], r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h);
718	    return;
719	  }
720	  // desert
721	  // ① 396→396→397(DesertHouseBuilder.cs:31):Dither(0.8)+Blotches(2,0.2)+
722	  //   OnlyTiles(396)+SetTileKeepWall(396)+Dither(0.5)+SetTileKeepWall(397)
723	  //   ——第一段写 396 是原版字面(视觉 no-op),但第二道 Dither 的掷骰位置在此
724	  genRect(st, rng, [
725	    { k: 'dither', p: 0.8 }, B2(0.2), { k: 'onlyTiles', types: [def.tile] },
726	    { k: 'setTileKeepWall', tile: def.tile },
727	    { k: 'dither', p: 0.5 }, { k: 'setTileKeepWall', tile: HARDSAND397 },
728	  ], r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h);
729	  // ② 顶/底行钟乳石(DesertHouseBuilder.cs:32-33,曾整体缺失 C5):
730	  //   Dither(0.5)+OnlyTiles(397,396)+Offset(0,1)+ActionStalagtite
731	  for (const rowY of [r.y, r.y + r.h - 1]) {
732	    genRect(st, rng, [
733	      { k: 'dither', p: 0.5 }, { k: 'onlyTiles', types: [HARDSAND397, def.tile] },
734	      { k: 'offset', dx: 0, dy: 1 }, { k: 'stalagtite' },
735	    ], r.x + 1, rowY, r.w - 2, 1);
736	  }
737	  // ③ 墙 216(DesertHouseBuilder.cs:34):Dither(0.8)+Blotches()+OnlyWalls(187)
738	  genRect(st, rng, [
739	    { k: 'dither', p: 0.8 }, B2(0.3), { k: 'onlyWalls', types: [def.wall] }, { k: 'placeWall', wall: 216 },
740	  ], r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h);
741	}

743	// ---------- FillRooms(画/烛台交替 + 装饰循环) ----------
744	function fillRooms(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, r: Rect, def: ThemeDef, theme: Theme): void {
745	  // 家具七选(HouseBuilder.FillRooms choices;沙漠 Tables2 → tile 469)
746	  const choices: Array<[string, number]> = [
747	    [def.tables2 ? 'v_469_tables_group_2' : 'table', def.table],
748	    ['anvil', 0],
749	    ['workbench', def.workbench],
750	    ['v_86_loom', 0],
751	    ['piano', def.piano],
752	    ['keg', 0],
753	    ['bookcase', def.bookcase],
754	  ];
755	  // 画/烛台交替:switch(i + parity%2) 仅 0/1 两档有内容(i≥2 落空,原版同款)。
756	  //   ★HouseBuilder.cs:434-458 是裸 switch case 0/1——i≥2(w≥24 房 n=3 的第三档)
757	  //   【无 case 落空:零放置零掷】;曾用 %2 取模回卷 → i=2 误放画/吊灯+多掷
758	  //   RandHousePicture/Next(6)(house8 首个 30 宽房 FillRooms 61 vs vanilla 58 实锤)
759	  const n = Math.floor(r.w / 8);
760	  const step = Math.floor(r.w / (n + 1));
761	  const parity = rng.int(0, 1);
762	  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
763	    const x = (i + 1) * step + r.x;
764	    const sw = i + (parity % 2);
765	    if (sw > 1) continue;
766	    if (sw === 0) {
767	      // 画:Y + min(H/2, H-5)
768	      const y = r.y + Math.min(Math.floor(r.h / 2), r.h - 5);
769	      const [key, style] = theme === 'desert' ? randHousePictureDesert(rng) : randHousePicture(rng);
770	      // 画放置零掷【勘误 2026-08-17】：PlaceTile(240/241/242/245/246) 走专属 Place*Wall
771	      // 分支（WorldGen.cs:59962-59990），Place2x3Wall(245)/Place3x3Wall(240) 等纯放置
772	      // 全零 genRand（:44595/:44281 实读）；TileObject.Place 的 Main.rand.Next(4)
773	      // （TileObject.cs:792）永不达——且 genRand=>Main.rand（WorldGen.cs:4391）单流下
774	      // houseprobe4 PT(240) 事件 Δ0 掷实锤。旧「245 补 Next(4)」系误判 PlaceTile→
775	      // PlaceObject 派发，已撤。
776	      placeFurniture(st, key, x, y, style);
777	    } else {
778	      // 烛台:PlaceChand(34)吊灯——key=chandelier(sheet 34;旧误用 'candelabra'
779	      // =sheet 100 的独立件,case 34 永不命中 → 吊灯从未放置,room1 实锤)
780	      const y = r.y + 1;
781	      placeFurniture(st, 'chandelier', x, y, rng.int(0, 5));
782	    }
783	  }
784	  // 装饰循环:W/8+3 件
785	  const decoCount = Math.floor(r.w / 8) + 3;
786	  for (let k = 0; k < decoCount; k++) {
787	    const x = rng.int(0, r.w - 4) + 1 + r.x;
788	    const y = r.y + r.h - 2;
789	    switch (rng.int(0, 3)) {
790	      case 0: {
791	        // 小堆 185(HouseBuilder.cs:479)：style=Next(31,34) 在【调用点】恒掷
792	        // （_random.Next(31,34) 先求值再进 PlaceSmallPile，占用与否是体内判定）——
793	        // 旧实现把掷骰关进 !activeAt 门 → 占用格漏掷（houseprobe4 实锤：house0
794	        // roomA it3 (765,871) 掷位 3079 处 vanilla 已掷 style、JS 直落下一迭代）。
795	        // PlaceSmallPile size1(cs:46831)：2 宽 (x..x+1,y)，门=!anyLava+下方双格
796	        // SolidTile2+双格 !active+type185 拒 Boulders 垫；帧 frameX=style*36(+18)/frameY=18
797	        const style = rng.int(31, 33);
798	        const lava = st.inBounds(x, y) && st.liquid[st.idx(x, y)] > 0 && st.liquidType[st.idx(x, y)] === 2;
799	        if (!lava && solid2(st, x, y + 1) && solid2(st, x + 1, y + 1)
800	          && !BOULDERS.has(sheetOf(st, x, y + 1)) && !BOULDERS.has(sheetOf(st, x + 1, y + 1))
801	          && st.inBounds(x + 1, y) && !activeAt(st, x, y) && !activeAt(st, x + 1, y)) {
802	          st.setTileSilent(x, y, SMALL_PILE, style * 36, 18);
803	          st.setTileSilent(x + 1, y, SMALL_PILE, style * 36 + 18, 18);
804	          regHouseObj(st, x, y, 2, 1, 'floor');
805	        }
806	        break;
807	      }
808	      case 1: // 骨堆 186
809	        placeFurniture(st, 'v_186_decos_3x2', x, y, rng.int(22, 25));
810	        break;
811	      case 2: // 雕像(statueList[Next(2, len)],陷阱雕像照接)
812	        placeStatue(st, x, y, rng.int(2, STATUE_LIST.length - 1));
813	        break;
814	      case 3: {
815	        const [key, style] = choices[rng.int(0, choices.length - 1)];
816	        placeFurniture(st, key, x, y, style);
817	        break;
818	      }
819	    }
820	  }
821	}
822	
823	// ---------- 楼梯 / 门 / 平台 / 梁 ----------
824	/** CreateStairsList + PlaceStairs:相邻房间对角平台链 + 顶步 4×1 平台 + 斜坡 */
825	function placeStairs(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, rooms: Rect[], def: ThemeDef): void {
826	  for (let i = 1; i < rooms.length; i++) {
827	    const cur = rooms[i], prev = rooms[i - 1];
828	    const leftGap = prev.x - cur.x;
829	    const rightGap = cur.x + cur.w - (prev.x + prev.w);
830	    let from: { x: number; y: number };
831	    if (leftGap > rightGap) from = { x: cur.x + cur.w - 1, y: cur.y + 1 };
832	    else from = { x: cur.x, y: cur.y + 1 };
833	    const steps = (cur.y + cur.h - 1) - from.y;
834	    const dir = leftGap > rightGap ? -1 : 1;
835	    for (let s = 0; s < steps; s++) {
836	      const sx = from.x + dir * (s + 1), sy = from.y + s;
837	      if (!st.inBounds(sx, sy)) continue;
838	      // 平台帧 = PlaceTile(19, PlatformStyle)(HouseBuilder.cs:518)——case 19 走
839	      // frameY = 18*style(WorldGen.cs:60245-60249),非 frameX;曾恒写 (0,0)(C6)
840	      st.setTileSilent(sx, sy, PLATFORM, 0, def.platformStyle * 18);
841	      st.slope[st.idx(sx, sy)] = dir === 1 ? 1 : 2;
842	    }
843	    // 顶步上方 4×1 平台(HouseBuilder.cs:519)：Gen(Chain(Clear(), PlaceWall(WallType),
844	    //   PlaceTile(19)))——★PlaceWall 逐格走墙重帧掷（Actions.Clear 清 tile+wall+liquid
845	    //   后置墙 → 自格+四邻 SquareWallFrame 判定掷，尾批 2-C 墙掷模型）
846	    const px = from.x + (dir === 1 ? 1 : -4);
847	    for (let dx = 0; dx < 4; dx++) {
848	      const cx = px + dx, cy = from.y - 1;
849	      if (!st.inBounds(cx, cy)) continue;
850	      st.setTileSilent(cx, cy, 0);
851	      st.liquid[st.idx(cx, cy)] = 0;
852	      st.liquidType[st.idx(cx, cy)] = 0;
853	      placeWallRolled(st, rng, cx, cy, def.wall);
854	      st.setTileSilent(cx, cy, PLATFORM, 0, def.platformStyle * 18);
855	    }
856	  }
857	}

859	/** FindSideExit(Up 搜索 + AreaOr(4,3) 任一非实心) */
860	function findSideExit(st: TileStore, wallX: number, wallY: number, wallH: number, isLeft: boolean): number | null {
861	  // FindSideExit（HouseBuilder.cs:554）：Up 搜索 + IsSolid().Not().AreaOr(4,3)。
862	  //   ★GenCondition.IsValid Or 分支（GenCondition.cs:52-61）+InvertResults：任一格
863	  //   CheckValidity(=实心)成立→返回 !Invert=false；全空才 true——即 4×3 窗口必须
864	  //   【整体无实心】才命中。曾误读成 any-非实心 → 门/平台滥发（house0 右窗外
865	  //   (769,869) 一格泥土即否决,旧 any 语义误命中实锤）
866	  const startX = wallX + (isLeft ? -4 : 0);
867	  for (let k = 0; k < wallH - 3; k++) {
868	    const y = wallY + wallH - 3 - k;
869	    let allAir = true;
870	    for (let dx = 0; dx < 4 && allAir; dx++) {
871	      for (let dy = 0; dy < 3 && allAir; dy++) {
872	        if (solidAt(st, startX + dx, y + dy)) allAir = false;
873	      }
874	    }
875	    if (allAir) return y;
876	  }
877	  return null;
878	}

880	function placeDoors(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, rooms: Rect[], def: ThemeDef): void {
881	  for (const r of rooms) {
882	    // 墙列矩形 (X, Y+1, 1, H-2)
883	    // 门禁（原版 PlaceTile(x, exitY)→PlaceDoor(j+1)，WorldGen.cs:31946）：mount
884	    // （exitY-1 实心）+ 地板（exitY+3 实心）缺一即不放门只留门洞——HouseBuilder
885	    // 的 forced=true 仅绕过首道空格门，门分支的锚点条件仍生效
886	    const tryDoor = (x: number, exitY: number) => {
887	      for (let dy = 0; dy < 3; dy++) st.setTileSilent(x, exitY + dy, 0);
888	      // PlaceTile case10（cs:59867-59906，forced=true 仅过首道空格门）：分支 A
889	      // （exitY-1/-2 空 + exitY-3 实心）→ PlaceDoor(i,j-1) 门落 (exitY-2..exitY)；
890	      // 分支 B（exitY+1/+2 空 + exitY+3 实心）→ 门落 (exitY..exitY+2)；双败→无门零掷
891	      const solidAtV = (yy: number) => st.inBounds(x, yy) && !!st.flags[st.idx(x, yy)] && vanGenSolidType(st.type[st.idx(x, yy)]);
892	      const inactiveAt = (yy: number) => st.inBounds(x, yy) && st.flags[st.idx(x, yy)] === 0;
893	      if (inactiveAt(exitY - 1) && inactiveAt(exitY - 2) && solidAtV(exitY - 3)) {
894	        // PlaceDoor（cs:31938-31960）：三格门框 frameX 各独立掷 Next(3)——每门 3 掷
895	        // （N 批 HellFort 同源；house3 vanilla DO→PL=6 掷=双门×3 实锤）
896	        rng.int(0, 2); rng.int(0, 2); rng.int(0, 2);
897	        placeDoorClosed(st, x, exitY - 2, def.door);
898	      } else if (inactiveAt(exitY + 1) && inactiveAt(exitY + 2) && solidAtV(exitY + 3)) {
899	        rng.int(0, 2); rng.int(0, 2); rng.int(0, 2);
900	        placeDoorClosed(st, x, exitY, def.door);
901	      }
902	    };
903	    // 右侧扫描起点 = room.X+W（墙体列外一格,HouseBuilder.cs:562 wall=(X+W,Y+1,1,H-2)）
904	    // ——曾误用墙体列 X+W-1 → 扫描窗含恒实心墙列,门外洞穴 4×3 极易命中 → 门滥发
905	    // （house1 vanilla 无门 vs JS 误门 (2045,352) 实锤）
906	    const exitR = findSideExit(st, r.x + r.w, r.y + 1, r.h - 2, false);
907	    if (exitR !== null) tryDoor(r.x + r.w - 1, exitR);
908	    const exitL = findSideExit(st, r.x, r.y + 1, r.h - 2, true);
909	    if (exitL !== null) tryDoor(r.x, exitL);
910	  }
911	}

913	/** FindVerticalExit(Left 搜索 + AreaOr(3,5) 任一非实心) */
914	function findVerticalExit(st: TileStore, rectX: number, rectY: number, rectW: number, isUp: boolean): number | null {
915	  const startX = rectX + rectW - 3;
916	  const startY = rectY + (isUp ? -5 : 0);
917	  for (let k = 0; k < rectW - 3; k++) {
918	    const x = startX - k;
919	    // 同 findSideExit：AreaOr(3,5)+Not = 3×5 窗口整体无实心才命中（曾误 any 语义）
920	    let allAir = true;
921	    for (let dx = 0; dx < 3 && allAir; dx++) {
922	      for (let dy = 0; dy < 5 && allAir; dy++) {
923	        if (solidAt(st, x + dx, startY + dy)) allAir = false;
924	      }
925	    }
926	    if (allAir) return x;
927	  }
928	  return null;
929	}

931	function placePlatforms(st: TileStore, rooms: Rect[], def: ThemeDef): void {
932	  const top = rooms[0], bot = rooms[rooms.length - 1];
933	  // 顶层顶壁(isUp:候选自壁上 5 格起);帧同楼梯(C6):HouseBuilder.cs:574
934	  //   PlaceTile(19, PlatformStyle) → frameY = 18*style
935	  const exitT = findVerticalExit(st, top.x + 2, top.y, top.w - 4, true);
936	  if (exitT !== null) {
937	    for (let dx = 0; dx < 3; dx++) st.setTileSilent(exitT + dx, top.y, PLATFORM, 0, def.platformStyle * 18);
938	  }
939	  if (rooms.length > 1) {
940	    const exitB = findVerticalExit(st, bot.x + 2, bot.y + bot.h - 1, bot.w - 4, false);
941	    if (exitB !== null) {
942	      for (let dx = 0; dx < 3; dx++) st.setTileSilent(exitB + dx, bot.y + bot.h - 1, PLATFORM, 0, def.platformStyle * 18);
943	    }
944	  }
945	}

947	/** CreateSupportBeamList + PlaceSupportBeams:6→4 步长梁列,落下一房顶/实心 */
948	function placeSupportBeams(st: TileStore, rooms: Rect[], def: ThemeDef): void {
949	  const minX = Math.min(...rooms.map((r) => r.x));
950	  const maxX = Math.max(...rooms.map((r) => r.x + r.w)) - 1;
951	  let step = 6;
952	  while (step > 4 && (maxX - minX) % step !== 0) step--;
953	  for (let x = minX; x <= maxX; x += step) {
954	    for (let ri = 0; ri < rooms.length; ri++) {
955	      const r = rooms[ri];
956	      if (x < r.x || x >= r.x + r.w) continue;
957	      const bottom = r.y + r.h;
958	      let limit = 50;
959	      for (let rj = ri + 1; rj < rooms.length; rj++) {
960	        const r2 = rooms[rj];
961	        if (x >= r2.x && x < r2.x + r2.w) limit = Math.min(limit, r2.y - bottom);
962	      }
963	      if (limit <= 0) continue;
964	      let found = -1;
965	      if (limit < 50) found = bottom + limit; // 原版:num7<50 视为命中下一房顶
966	      else {
967	        for (let y = bottom; y < bottom + limit; y++) {
968	          if (solidAt(st, x, y)) { found = y; break; }
969	        }
970	      }
971	      if (found < 0) continue;
972	      const height = found - bottom;
973	      if (height > 1 && st.type[st.idx(x, bottom - 1)] !== PLATFORM) {
974	        for (let y = bottom; y < found; y++) st.setTileSilent(x, y, def.beam, 0, 0);
975	      }
976	    }
977	  }
978	}

980	// ---------- 主题专属件级联(PlaceBiomeSpecificPriorityTool / PlaceBiomeSpecificTool) ----------
981	/** HouseBuilder.cs:764-826/838-865/881-907 共形级联:逐房【底行 Y+H-2】先 10 次
982	 *  随机(Next(2,W-2)+X)再整行扫描;仅 Bast 有顶行 Y-1 兜底级联(:798-825)。
983	 *  任一命中即停(true = 放置成功,调用方据此递增计数)。
984	 *  旧实现是"rooms[0] 单发随机公式"——三级级联与逐房推进全部缺失(C7) */
985	function cascadePlace(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, rooms: Rect[], key: string, ceilingFallback: boolean): boolean {
986	  const tryRow = (r: Rect, y: number): boolean => {
987	    for (let t = 0; t < 10; t++) {
988	      if (placeFurniture(st, key, rng.int(2, r.w - 3) + r.x, y)) return true;
989	    }
990	    // 扫描段「成功」= PlaceTile 返回值 = 锚格 active(★任意件——含既有家具!
991	    //   PlaceTile 尾段 `if (tile.active()) result=true`(cs:60279-60286)读的是
992	    //   锚格终态,Place3x2 被占失败时锚格若原就 active → 返回 true。vanilla
993	    //   house10 磨刀站 sweep 踩工作台 87 上 → flag=true 计数+1 而实际未放置
994	    //   ——SharpenerCount 与 JS 分歧 → house33 丛林门翻转(3<4 vs 4≥4)实锤)
995	    for (let x = r.x + 2; x <= r.x + r.w - 2; x++) {
996	      placeFurniture(st, key, x, y);
997	      if (activeAt(st, x, y)) return true;
998	    }
999	    return false;
1000	  };
1001	  for (const r of rooms) if (tryRow(r, r.y + r.h - 2)) return true;
1002	  if (ceilingFallback) {
1003	    for (const r of rooms) if (tryRow(r, r.y - 1)) return true;
1004	  }
1005	  return false;
1006	}

1008	// ---------- 宝箱四级联(PlaceChests) ----------
1009	function placeChests(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState, chests: ChestSink, rooms: Rect[], def: ThemeDef, theme: Theme): void {
1010	  // 头掷（HouseBuilder.cs:672）：`NextDouble() > ChestChance` —— ChestChance=1.0
1011	  // 恒过门但【掷骰照耗】。旧实现缺此掷 → 箱段流漂 -1（house0 AB#558 dk=-1 实锤）
1012	  rng.next();
1013	  const tryAt = (x: number, y: number): boolean => {
1014	    const underground = y > gs.worldSurface;
1015	    // 冰屋：显式 style 11 直入冰箱门（cs:36107 第一析取）→ 主件池 + 1/20 提炼机 +
1016	    // 1/50 鱼覆盖块自动生效（旧实现显式 loot 绕过覆盖——审计三.4 修复）
1017	    return placeBuriedChest(st, rng, gs, chests, x, y, {
1018	      style: underground ? def.chestStyle : 0,
1019	      tile: underground && def.chestTile2 ? CHEST2 : undefined,
1020	      flags: theme === 'ice' ? { ice: true } : (!underground ? { wooden: true } : {}),
1021	    });
1022	  };
1023	  // 级联 1:各房底行随机 10 次
1024	  for (const r of rooms) {
1025	    const floorY = r.y + r.h - 1;
1026	    let ok = false;
1027	    for (let t = 0; t < 10 && !ok; t++) ok = tryAt(rng.int(2, r.w - 3) + r.x, floorY);
1028	    if (ok) return;
1029	    for (let x = r.x + 2; x <= r.x + r.w - 2 && !ok; x++) ok = tryAt(x, floorY);
1030	    if (ok) return;
1031	  }
1032	  // 级联 2:各房顶行(Y-1)
1033	  for (const r of rooms) {
1034	    const ceilY = r.y - 1;
1035	    let ok = false;
1036	    for (let t = 0; t < 10 && !ok; t++) ok = tryAt(rng.int(2, r.w - 3) + r.x, ceilY);
1037	    if (ok) return;
1038	    for (let x = r.x + 2; x <= r.x + r.w - 2 && !ok; x++) ok = tryAt(x, ceilY);
1039	    if (ok) return;
1040	  }
1041	  // 级联 3:房外 ±30 随机 1000 次
1042	  for (let t = 0; t < 1000; t++) {
1043	    if (tryAt(rng.int(rooms[0].x - 30, rooms[0].x + 29), rng.int(rooms[0].y - 30, rooms[0].y + 29))) return;
1044	  }
1045	}

1047	// ---------- pass 主体 ----------
1048	/** 地下小屋 pass(UndergroundHousesAndBuriedChests 的 CaveHouse 段,cs:17153-17192
1049	 *  + 沙漠追加段 cs:17193-17219) */
1050	/** pass 59 头四计数连掷(cs:17081-17084,序=CaveHouse→Underworld→CaveChest→
1051	 *  AdditionalDesert)——本仓 pass 拆分后各消费 pass 流位分散,由本函数在管线中
1052	 *  第一个消费 pass 之前统一预掷暂存 gs(WorldGen.ts 接线)。四枚均为
1053	 *  WorldGenRange.GetRandom(WorldGenRange.cs:34-57:先缩放边界再截断):
1054	 *  CaveHouse/CaveChest=35-40×WorldArea、Underworld=10-15×WorldWidth/4200、
1055	 *  AdditionalDesert=2-2×WorldArea(恒掷一骰)。幂等:已预掷(≥0)直接返回。 */
1056	export function rollHouseChestCounts(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState): void {
1057	  if (gs.caveHouseCount >= 0) return;
1058	  const area = (st.w * st.h) / 5040000;
1059	  const wsc = st.w / 4200;
1060	  gs.caveHouseCount = rng.int(Math.trunc(35 * area), Math.trunc(40 * area));
1061	  gs.underworldChestCount = rng.int(Math.trunc(10 * wsc), Math.trunc(15 * wsc));
1062	  gs.caveChestCount = rng.int(Math.trunc(35 * area), Math.trunc(40 * area));
1063	  gs.desertHouseCount = rng.int(Math.trunc(2 * area), Math.trunc(2 * area));
1064	}

1066	export function runCaveHousesPass(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState, chests: ChestSink): void {
1067	  // ★pass 头 tileSolid 翻转（cs:17076-17079）：226 蜥蜴砖/162 薄冰/225 蜂巢块/
1068	  //   190 荧光菇块短暂回**实心**——本 pass 的房间寻找/锚定（findRoom 的 solidAt /
1069	  //   HouseUtils.AreRoomsValid）把它们当可建地面。pass 尾（cs:17220-23）翻回 false。
1070	  flipGenSolid([226, 162, 225, 190], true);
1071	  const { w, h } = st;
1072	  // CaveHouseCount 35-40 × WorldArea/5040000(Configuration.json)。WorldGenRange.
1073	  // GetRandom(WorldGenRange.cs:34-40)= Next(ScaledMinimum, ScaledMaximum+1),
1074	  // ScaleValue(:42-57)先按面积缩放边界再 (int) 截断——即
1075	  // Next((int)(35*s), (int)(40*s)+1)。旧实现"先掷后乘 + Math.round",分布不同(C10)。
1076	  // 另:原版 pass 头连掷四枚(cs:17081-17084:CaveHouseCount→UnderworldChestCount→
1077	  // CaveChestCount→AdditionalDesertHouseCount);由 rollHouseChestCounts 在管线里
1078	  // **先于**本 pass 统一预掷(WorldGen.ts 接线),本 pass 只消费 gs 暂存值
1079	  // (探针直调未预掷时回退自掷)。
1080	  const s = (w * h) / 5040000;
1081	  const count = gs.caveHouseCount >= 0 ? gs.caveHouseCount : rng.int(Math.trunc(35 * s), Math.trunc(40 * s));
1082	  // 第 4 个 WorldGenRange：AdditionalDesertHouseCount（2-2 × WorldArea，
1083	  // Configuration.json）——GetRandom 恒消费一次 Next（cs:17084）
1084	  const desertHouses = gs.desertHouseCount >= 0 ? gs.desertHouseCount : rng.int(2, 2);
1085	  let bastCount = 0;        // GenVars.extraBastStatueCount
1086	  // extraBastStatueCountMax(WorldGen.cs:11490-11499)= 2+尺寸档:大(≥8400)+2、
1087	  // 中(≥6400)+1、小 +0——旧实现硬编码 2,仅小世界正确(C7)
1088	  const bastMax = 2 + (w >= 8400 ? 2 : w >= 6400 ? 1 : 0);
1089	  let extractCount = 0;     // HouseBuilderContext.ExtractinatorCount
1090	  let sharpCount = 0;       // context.SharpenerCount
1091	
1092	  /** 单座小屋放置（HouseBuilder.Place 原序），返回是否成功 */
1093	  // 阶段探针（对拍 vanilla stage hook；tag 对应 HouseBuilder 私有方法边界）
1094	  const __st = (globalThis as { __swHouseStage?: (tag: string, a: number, b: number, c: number, d: number) => void }).__swHouseStage;
1095	  const __rn = () => (globalThis as { __swRollN?: number }).__swRollN ?? -1;
1096	  const placeHouse = (ox: number, oy: number, oceanGate: boolean): boolean => {
1097	    // oceanDepths 1:1(cs:10978-10988):【先 y 门】y > oceanLevel((Main.worldSurface
1098	    //   + Main.rockLayer)/2+40,双 double)即非海洋直接 false——地下小屋 oy 取自
1099	    //   worldSurfaceHigh+20 起的深域,恒 > oceanLevel,原版此门从不触发;曾只抄
1100	    //   x 半边 → 海滩 x 带内深埋尝试被误拒 → createRooms 的 above/below 2 掷被吞
1101	    //   → 流漂(house5 前尝试 (3901,718) vanilla 2 掷 vs JS 0 掷,AB#565 (579,445)
1102	    //   vs (885,736) 首异实锤)
1103	    if (oceanGate && !(oy > (gs.worldSurface + gs.rockLevel) / 2 + 40)
1104	      && (ox < gs.beachDistance || ox > w - gs.beachDistance)) return false;
1105	    // CaveHouseBiome.Place 前置拒绝(CaveHouseBiome.cs:36-54,C9 曾整体缺失):
1106	    //   InWorld(origin,30) + 原点 ±25 内有红线或 BasicChest(21/467,TileID.cs:315)
1107	    //   → 整屋放弃。须在 createRooms 之前(不耗 RNG)。
1108	    if (ox < 30 || oy < 30 || ox >= w - 30 || oy >= h - 30) return false;
1109	    for (let i = ox - 25; i <= ox + 25; i++) {
1110	      for (let j = oy - 25; j <= oy + 25; j++) {
1111	        const k = st.idx(i, j);
1112	        if ((st.wire[k] & TileStore.WIRE_RED) !== 0) return false; // tile.wire()(红线位)
1113	        const t = st.type[k];
1114	        if (t === CHEST21 || t === CHEST2) return false;           // TileID.Sets.BasicChest
1115	      }
1116	    }
1117	    const rooms = createRooms(st, rng, ox, oy);
1118	    if (!rooms.length) return false;
1119	    // 位置合法(InWorld 10 边距 / 底部 < h-220)。★无房间互斥检查——原版 above/below
1120	    //   房与主房天然重叠（HouseUtils.AreRoomLocationsValid 只查 InWorld+底界；x86
1121	    //   house0 实测 (753,865,15×8)+(749,872,17×8) 重叠共存）。曾加互斥门 → 42/42
1122	    //   只剩 15×8 单房（vanilla 21 单/17 双/4 三房）——房屋链欠掷另一半根因（2-C）
1123	    let ok = true;
1124	    for (const r of rooms) {
1125	      if (r.x < 10 || r.y < 10 || r.x + r.w > w - 10 || r.y + r.h > h - 220) ok = false;
1126	    }
1127	    if (!ok) return false;
1128	    const theme = getHouseType(st, rooms);
1129	    const def = THEMES[theme];
1130	    if (def.tile < 0 || def.beam < 0) return false;
1131	    // 岩浆回避(granite 主题豁免,HouseUtils.AreRoomsValid)
1132	    if (theme !== 'granite') {
1133	      for (const r of rooms) {

	private List<Tuple<Point, Point>> CreateStairsList()
	{
		List<Tuple<Point, Point>> list = new List<Tuple<Point, Point>>();
		for (int i = 1; i < Rooms.Count; i++)
		{
			Rectangle rectangle = Rooms[i];
			Rectangle rectangle2 = Rooms[i - 1];
			int num = rectangle2.X - rectangle.X;
			int num2 = rectangle.X + rectangle.Width - (rectangle2.X + rectangle2.Width);
			if (num > num2)
			{
				list.Add(new Tuple<Point, Point>(new Point(rectangle.X + rectangle.Width - 1, rectangle.Y + 1), new Point(rectangle.X + rectangle.Width - rectangle.Height + 1, rectangle.Y + rectangle.Height - 1)));
			}
			else
			{
				list.Add(new Tuple<Point, Point>(new Point(rectangle.X, rectangle.Y + 1), new Point(rectangle.X + rectangle.Height - 1, rectangle.Y + rectangle.Height - 1)));
			}
		}
		return list;
	}

	private List<Point> CreateDoorList()
	{
		List<Point> list = new List<Point>();

			if (FindSideExit(new Rectangle(room.X + room.Width, room.Y + 1, 1, room.Height - 2), isLeft: false, out var exitY))

20:export function placeDoorClosed(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number, style: number, variant = 0): void {
export function placeDoorClosed(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number, style: number, variant = 0): void {
  const [fx, fy] = doorClosedFrame(style, variant);
  for (let dy = 0; dy < 3; dy++) {
    if (st.inBounds(x, y + dy)) st.setTileSilent(x, y + dy, T.DOOR_CLOSED, fx, fy + dy * 18);
  }
}

/** 挖除含 (x,y) 格的整扇门（关门 1×3 / 开门 2×3，帧内偏移 = frame%/格步长）。
 *  返回掉落锚点；非门格返回 null。 */
export function clearDoorAt(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number): [number, number] | null {
  const t = st.get(x, y);
  if (t !== T.DOOR_CLOSED && t !== T.DOOR_OPEN) return null;
  const i = st.idx(x, y);
  const w = t === T.DOOR_OPEN ? 2 : 1;
  const col = Math.floor(st.frameX[i] / 18) % w;
  const row = Math.floor(st.frameY[i] / 18) % 3;
  const ax = x - col, ay = y - row;
  for (let dx = 0; dx < w; dx++) {
    for (let dy = 0; dy < 3; dy++) {
      if (st.inBounds(ax + dx, ay + dy) && st.get(ax + dx, ay + dy) === t) st.setTile(ax + dx, ay + dy, 0);
    }
  }
  return [ax, ay];
}

/** 开门（原版 OpenDoor 语义）。direction: 玩家面朝方向 ±1。
 *  返回 false = 目标侧被挡（调用方应换 -direction 重试）。 */
export function openDoor(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number, direction: number): boolean {
  if (st.get(x, y) !== T.DOOR_CLOSED) return false;
  // 锚点行：frameY % 54 === 0
  let ay = y;
  while (st.get(x, ay) === T.DOOR_CLOSED && st.frameY[st.idx(x, ay)] % 54 !== 0) {
    if (--ay < 0) return false;
  }
  if (st.get(x, ay) !== T.DOOR_CLOSED) return false;
  const ai = st.idx(x, ay);
  const style = doorStyleOf(st.frameX[ai], st.frameY[ai]);
  const col = Math.floor(style / 36), row = style % 36;
  // 目标侧列仅许可砍切格（原版 OpenDoor cs:37698-37715：!tileCut && !=165 && !drip 才失败），
  // 可砍格随后碎掉（:37717-37724 KillTile）。★曾保守要求全空=蛛网堵门永远打不开（偏差）
  const clearX = direction === -1 ? x - 1 : x + 1;

interface Boundary { gs: GenState; gensolid: Map<number, boolean>; fx: Uint16Array; fy: Uint16Array; wire: Uint8Array; ids35: Map<number, number>; chests: unknown[] }
const bCache = new Map<string, Boundary>();
function boundary(key: string): Boundary {
  const hit = bCache.get(key);
  if (hit) return hit;
  const dir = `${BDIR}/${key}`;
  if (!existsSync(`${dir}/gs.json`)) throw new Error(`no boundary ${key}`);
  const gs = JSON.parse(readFileSync(`${dir}/gs.json`, 'utf8')) as GenState;
  const gensolid = new Map(JSON.parse(readFileSync(`${dir}/gensolid.json`, 'utf8')) as Array<[number, boolean]>);
  const fw = new Uint32Array(readFileSync(`${dir}/frames.bin`).buffer.slice(0));
  const fx = new Uint16Array(N), fy = new Uint16Array(N), wire = new Uint8Array(N);
  for (let q = 0; q < fw.length; q += 4) { const i = fw[q]!; fx[i] = fw[q + 1]!; fy[i] = fw[q + 2]!; wire[i] = fw[q + 3]! & 0x1f; }
  const iw = new Uint32Array(readFileSync(`${dir}/ids35.bin`).buffer.slice(0));
  const ids35 = new Map<number, number>();
  for (let q = 0; q < iw.length; q += 2) ids35.set(iw[q]!, iw[q + 1]!);
  const chests = JSON.parse(readFileSync(`${dir}/chests.json`, 'utf8')) as unknown[];
  const b: Boundary = { gs, gensolid, fx, fy, wire, ids35, chests };
  bCache.set(key, b);
  return b;
}

interface PrevOut { type: Uint16Array; flags: Uint8Array; fx: Uint16Array; fy: Uint16Array; wire: Uint8Array }
function buildHybrid(baseIdx: number, b: Boundary | PrevOut): { st: TileStore; revMiss: number } {
  const c = chans(baseIdx);
  const st = new TileStore(W, H);
  const fromB = 'ids35' in b;
  const ids35 = fromB ? (b as Boundary).ids35 : null;
  let revMiss = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
    const act = c.a[i]!;
    st.flags[i] = act;
    if (act || c.t[i]) {
      const sh = c.t[i]!;
      let id = ids35 && ids35.has(i) ? ids35.get(i)! : -1;
      if (id < 0 || SHEET[id] !== sh) { id = REV.get(sh) ?? -1; }
      if (id < 0) { id = 0; revMiss++; }
      st.type[i] = id;
    } else st.type[i] = 0;
    st.wall[i] = c.w[i]!;
    st.liquid[i] = c.l[i]!;
    st.liquidType[i] = c.l[i] ? c.lt[i]! + 1 : 0;
    st.half[i] = c.hf[i]!;
    st.slope[i] = c.sl[i]!;
    st.wire[i] = c.ia[i]! ? 0x20 : 0;
    if (fromB) {
      const bb = b as Boundary;
      st.frameX[i] = bb.fx[i]; st.frameY[i] = bb.fy[i];
      st.wire[i] |= bb.wire[i];
    } else {
      const p = b as PrevOut;
      st.frameX[i] = p.fx[i]; st.frameY[i] = p.fy[i];
      st.wire[i] |= p.wire[i] & 0x1f;
    }
  }
  return { st, revMiss };
}

interface Row { idx: number; tag: string; dA: number; dT: number; dW: number; dL: number; dHf: number; dSl: number; dLt: number; dIa: number; first: string; pairs: Array<[string, number]>; samples: string[] }
function diffStore(tag: string, idx: number, st: TileStore): Row {

  const pair = new Map<string, number>();
  let firstI = -1;
  const mark = (i: number) => { if (firstI < 0) firstI = i; };
  for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
    const va = c.a[i]!, ja = st.flags[i]! & 1;
    if (va !== ja) { r.dA++; mark(i); if (r.samples.length < 10) r.samples.push(`A(${i % W},${(i / W) | 0}) v${va} j${ja}`); }
    const vt = va ? c.t[i]! : 0;
    const jt = ja ? (SHEET[st.type[i]!] >= 0 ? SHEET[st.type[i]!]! : 9999) : 0;
    if (vt !== jt) { r.dT++; mark(i); const k = `T${vt}>${jt}`; pair.set(k, (pair.get(k) ?? 0) + 1); if (r.samples.length < 10) r.samples.push(`T(${i % W},${(i / W) | 0}) v${vt} j${jt}`); }
    if (c.w[i]! !== st.wall[i]!) { r.dW++; mark(i); if (r.samples.length < 10) r.samples.push(`W(${i % W},${(i / W) | 0}) v${c.w[i]} j${st.wall[i]}`); }
    if (c.l[i]! !== st.liquid[i]!) { r.dL++; mark(i); if (r.samples.length < 10) r.samples.push(`L(${i % W},${(i / W) | 0}) v${c.l[i]} j${st.liquid[i]}`); }
    if (c.hf[i]! !== st.half[i]!) { r.dHf++; mark(i); const k = `H${c.hf[i]}>${st.half[i]}`; pair.set(k, (pair.get(k) ?? 0) + 1); if (r.samples.length < 10) r.samples.push(`H(${i % W},${(i / W) | 0}) v${c.hf[i]} j${st.half[i]}`); }
    if (c.sl[i]! !== st.slope[i]!) { r.dSl++; mark(i); const k = `S${c.sl[i]}>${st.slope[i]}`; pair.set(k, (pair.get(k) ?? 0) + 1); if (r.samples.length < 10) r.samples.push(`S(${i % W},${(i / W) | 0}) v${c.sl[i]} j${st.slope[i]}`); }
    const vl = c.l[i]! > 0 ? c.lt[i]! + 1 : 0;
    const jl = st.liquid[i]! > 0 ? st.liquidType[i]! : 0;
    if (vl !== jl) { r.dLt++; mark(i); const k = `Y${vl}>${jl}`; pair.set(k, (pair.get(k) ?? 0) + 1); if (r.samples.length < 10) r.samples.push(`Y(${i % W},${(i / W) | 0}) v${vl} j${jl} liq${c.l[i]}`); }
    const via = c.ia[i]! ? 1 : 0;
    const jia = (st.wire[i]! >>> 5) & 1;
    if (via !== jia) { r.dIa++; mark(i); if (r.samples.length < 10) r.samples.push(`I(${i % W},${(i / W) | 0}) v${via} j${jia}`); }
  }
  if (firstI >= 0) r.first = `(${firstI % W},${Math.floor(firstI / W)})`;
  r.pairs = [...pair.entries()].sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).slice(0, 8).map(([k, n]) => [k, n] as [string, number]);
  return r;
}
const isClean = (r: Row) => !(r.dA || r.dT || r.dW || r.dL || r.dHf || r.dSl || r.dLt || r.dIa);
function printRow(r: Row): void {

    `Hf=${String(r.dHf).padStart(5)} Sl=${String(r.dSl).padStart(5)} Lt=${String(r.dLt).padStart(4)} Ia=${String(r.dIa).padStart(4)} ${bad ? '✗ ' + r.first : '✓'}`);

}

interface SlotPlan { entry: string; steps: Step[] }

/** 跨槽生产者重算：shrineSpots / oceanTreasures（golden47/36 干净基座 + m_ 中途边界） */
function computeProducers(): { shrineSpots: Array<{ x: number; y: number }>; oceanTreasures: Array<{ x: number; y: number }> } {
  const mj = boundary('m_JungleShrines');
  const { st: stJ } = buildHybrid(47, mj);
  restoreGenSolid(mj.gensolid);
  const shrineSpots = runJungleShrinePass(stJ, new RNG(SEED), structuredClone(mj.gs) as GenState);
  const mo = boundary('m_OceanCaves');
  const { st: stO } = buildHybrid(36, mo);
  restoreGenSolid(mo.gensolid);
  const oceanTreasures = runOceanCavesPass(stO, new RNG(SEED), structuredClone(mo.gs) as GenState);
  return { shrineSpots, oceanTreasures };
}

async function runSettleStep(st: TileStore, gs: GenState, rng: RNG, world: World): Promise<void> {
  world.store = st;
  world.shimmerX = gs.shimmerX; world.shimmerY = gs.shimmerY;
  world.genWaterLine = gs.waterLine;
  if ((gs.dungeonSide as number) === 0) world.genDungeonExempt = null;
  else {
    const edge = Math.floor(world.w * 0.05), mid = Math.floor(world.w * 0.55);
    world.genDungeonExempt = gs.dungeonSide < 0
      ? { x0: edge, x1: Math.floor(world.w * 0.45), y0: Math.floor(gs.worldSurface) + 10, y1: (world.h - 200) - 10 }
      : { x0: mid, x1: world.w - edge, y0: Math.floor(gs.worldSurface) + 10, y1: (world.h - 200) - 10 };
  }
  await settleWorldLiquids(world, 'gen', undefined, rng);
  flipGenSolid([484], false);
}

  const t0 = Date.now();

  const plans = makePlans(producersBox);
  const world = new World(W, H, SEED);
  const rows: Row[] = [];

  const slots = [...plans.keys()].filter(s => {
    const ds = plans.get(s)!.steps.map(x => x.dump ?? 999).filter(d => d < 999);
    return ds.some(d => d >= FROM && d <= TO);
  }).sort((a, b) => a - b);
  for (const s of slots) {
    const plan = plans.get(s)!;
    if (plan.steps.some(x => x.dump === 61 || x.dump === 62) && !producersBox.shrineSpots) {
      const producers = computeProducers();
      producersBox.shrineSpots = producers.shrineSpots; producersBox.oceanTreasures = producers.oceanTreasures;
      console.log(`producers: shrineSpots=${producersBox.shrineSpots.length} oceanTreasures=${producersBox.oceanTreasures.length}`);
    }
    const entry = boundary(plan.entry);
    const gs: GenState = structuredClone(entry.gs);
    restoreGenSolid(entry.gensolid);
    __setGenStateForProbe(gs);
    const chests = structuredClone(entry.chests) as Chests;
    let prev: PrevOut | null = null;
    for (const step of plan.steps) {
      const built = prev ? buildHybrid(step.base, prev) : buildHybrid(step.base, entry);
      if (built.revMiss) console.log(`  [revMiss] base=${step.base} cells=${built.revMiss}`);
      const rng = new RNG(SEED);
      await step.run(built.st, gs, rng, chests, world);
      if (step.dump !== undefined && step.dump >= FROM && step.dump <= TO) {
        rows.push(diffStore(`jsSlot${s}`, step.dump, built.st));
      }
      prev = prevOf(built.st);
    }
    __setGenStateForProbe(null);
  }
  for (const r of rows) printRow(r);
  const bad = rows.filter(r => !isClean(r));
  console.log(`\n★ 尾段裁决 ${FROM}..${TO}: ${rows.length} 槽对拍，自因差槽 ${bad.length} 个`);
  for (const r of bad) console.log(`  ✗ #${r.idx} ${DUMPNAME.get(r.idx)} first=${r.first} pairs=${r.pairs.slice(0, 4).map(([k, n]) => `${k}×${n}`).join(' ')}`);
  console.log(`done ${((Date.now() - t0) / 1000).toFixed(0)}s`);
}, 560_000);

interface Cap { gs: GenState; solid: Map<number, boolean>; aux: { liquidType: Uint8Array; half: Uint8Array; slope: Uint8Array; wire: Uint8Array } }
const caps: Record<string, Cap> = {};

function cloneGs(gs: GenState): GenState {
  const c = { ...gs } as unknown as Record<string, unknown>;
  for (const k of Object.keys(c)) {
    const v = c[k];
    if (Array.isArray(v)) c[k] = v.map((e) => (e && typeof e === 'object' ? { ...(e as object) } : e));
    else if (v instanceof Int32Array) c[k] = v.slice();
    else if (v instanceof Float32Array) c[k] = v.slice();
    else if (v instanceof Uint8Array) c[k] = v.slice();
    else if (v && typeof v === 'object') c[k] = { ...(v as Record<string, unknown>) };
  }
  return c as unknown as GenState;
}

function countedRng(seed: number) {
  const rng = new RNG(seed);
  const ur = (rng as unknown as { ur: { internalSample: () => number } }).ur;
  const orig = ur.internalSample.bind(ur);
  const box = { n: 0 };
  const rolls: Array<[number, string, number, number, number]> = [];
  ur.internalSample = () => { box.n++; return orig(); };
  // RNG 门面日志：int/next 逐调用记 (k, 调用形, lo, hi, val)
  const g = globalThis as { __swRollLog?: Array<[number, string, number, number, number]> };
  if (g.__swRollLog) {
    for (const key of ['int', 'next'] as const) {
      const origFn = (rng[key] as (...a: number[]) => number).bind(rng);
      (rng[key] as unknown as (...a: number[]) => number) = (...a: number[]) => {
        const v = origFn(...a);
        g.__swRollLog!.push([box.n, key, a[0] ?? 0, a[1] ?? 0, v]);
        (globalThis as { __swRollN?: number }).__swRollN = box.n;
        return v;
      };
    }
  }
  return { rng, box };
}

function buildStore(idx: number, cap: Cap): TileStore {
  const t = loadT(idx), a = loadA(idx), w = loadW(idx), l = loadL(idx);
  // ★辅助通道改用 x86 真值 /tmp/chestd59（尾批 2-B ChestProbe D59：Buried Chests
  //   pass 头 slope/half/lty/wire 四通道裸数组——55-58 期间 slope/half 有 5 万格
  //   漂移，hs54 已陈旧）。
  let hHalf: Uint8Array | null = null, hSlope: Uint8Array | null = null, hLty: Uint8Array | null = null, hWire: Uint8Array | null = null;
  try {
    // ★尾批 2-C：/tmp/hg/chestd59v2 = SW_EVIL=0 与金标 dump 同跑的四通道（旧
    //   /tmp/chestd59 是自然邪恶首跑产物——half 有 10,939 格漂移，曾致落定/锚腿判定分叉）
    hHalf = new Uint8Array(readFileSync('/tmp/hg/chestd59v2.half'));
    hSlope = new Uint8Array(readFileSync('/tmp/hg/chestd59v2.slope'));
    hLty = new Uint8Array(readFileSync('/tmp/hg/chestd59v2.lty'));
    hWire = new Uint8Array(readFileSync('/tmp/hg/chestd59v2.wire'));
  } catch { /* 缺真值回退管线捕获 */ }
  const st = new TileStore(W, H);
  for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
    st.type[i] = REV.get(t[i]!) ?? 0;
    st.flags[i] = a[i] ? 1 : 0;
    st.wall[i] = w[i]!;
    st.liquid[i] = l[i]!;
    st.liquidType[i] = hLty ? hLty[i] : cap.aux.liquidType[i];       // D59 已按本仓 +1 编码（liquid>0 ? lty+1 : 0）
    st.half[i] = hHalf ? hHalf[i] : cap.aux.half[i];
    st.slope[i] = hSlope ? hSlope[i] : cap.aux.slope[i];
    st.wire[i] = hWire ? hWire[i] : cap.aux.wire[i];
  }
  return st;
}

interface DiffRes { typ: number; act: number; wal: number; liq: number; pairs: [string, number][]; samples: string[]; mask: Uint8Array }
function diff(st: TileStore, idx: number, label: string, prevMask?: Uint8Array): DiffRes {
  const t = loadT(idx), a = loadA(idx), w = loadW(idx), l = loadL(idx);
  let typ = 0, act = 0, wal = 0, liq = 0;
  const pairs = new Map<string, number>();
  const samples: string[] = [];
  const mask = new Uint8Array(N);
  for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
    let jT = st.type[i]; if (jT !== 0) jT = SHEET[jT] ?? -1;
    const dT = jT !== t[i], dA = (st.flags[i] !== 0) !== (a[i] !== 0), dW = st.wall[i] !== w[i], dL = st.liquid[i] !== l[i];
    if (!(dT || dA || dW || dL)) continue;
    mask[i] = 1;
    if (dT) { typ++; pairs.set(`t${jT}>${t[i]}`, (pairs.get(`t${jT}>${t[i]}`) ?? 0) + 1); }

//   关门 style = 36*(frameX/54) + frameY/54 —— 每列 36 个样式，frameX 只有 0/54 两列；
//   frameX = 变体(0/18/36 三张纹理) + 54*列，frameY = 54*(style%36) + 行内偏移(0/18/36)。
//   开门 frameX = 72*列 + (direction==-1 ? 36 : 0)（%72 后 0/36 为锚点列、18/54 为右侧列）。
// 本项目曾误用 frameX = style*54（横排），越界导致门贴图不可见/错位。
import type { TileStore } from './TileStore';
import { T, TILE_BY_KEY, doorSmashable } from '../data/tiles';

/** 关门锚点帧（顶格）：[frameX, frameY] */
export function doorClosedFrame(style: number, variant = 0): [number, number] {
  return [variant * 18 + 54 * Math.floor(style / 36), 54 * (style % 36)];
}

/** 由任意关门格帧反推 style */
export function doorStyleOf(fx: number, fy: number): number {
  return Math.floor(fx / 54) * 36 + Math.floor(fy / 54);
}

using System.Collections.Generic;
using Microsoft.Xna.Framework;
using Terraria.WorldBuilding;

namespace Terraria.GameContent.Biomes.CaveHouse;

public class WoodHouseBuilder : HouseBuilder
{
	public WoodHouseBuilder(IEnumerable<Rectangle> rooms)
		: base(HouseType.Wood, rooms)
	{
		base.TileType = 30;
		base.WallType = 27;
		base.BeamType = 124;
		base.PlatformStyle = 0;
		base.DoorStyle = 0;
		base.TableStyle = 0;
		base.WorkbenchStyle = 0;
		base.PianoStyle = 0;
		base.BookcaseStyle = 0;
		base.ChairStyle = 0;
		base.ChestStyle = 1;
		PotentiallyConvertToSeedHouse();
		PotentiallyConvertToRainbowBrick();
		PotentiallyConvertToRainbowMossBlock();
	}

	protected override void AgeRoom(Rectangle room)
	{
		for (int i = 0; i < room.Width * room.Height / 16; i++)
		{
			int x = WorldGen.genRand.Next(1, room.Width - 1) + room.X;
			int y = WorldGen.genRand.Next(1, room.Height - 1) + room.Y;
			WorldUtils.Gen(new Point(x, y), new Shapes.Rectangle(2, 2), Actions.Chain(new Modifiers.Dither(), new Modifiers.Blotches(2, 2), new Modifiers.IsEmpty(), new Actions.SetTile(51, setSelfFrames: true)));
		}
		WorldUtils.Gen(new Point(room.X, room.Y), new Shapes.Rectangle(room.Width, room.Height), Actions.Chain(new Modifiers.Dither(0.85), new Modifiers.Blotches(), new Modifiers.OnlyWalls(base.WallType), new Modifiers.SkipTiles(SkipTilesDuringWallAging), ((double)room.Y > Main.worldSurface) ? ((GenAction)new Actions.ClearWall(frameNeighbors: true)) : ((GenAction)new Actions.PlaceWall(2))));
		WorldUtils.Gen(new Point(room.X, room.Y), new Shapes.Rectangle(room.Width, room.Height), Actions.Chain(new Modifiers.Dither(0.95), new Modifiers.OnlyTiles(30, 321, 158), new Actions.ClearTile(frameNeighbors: true)));
	}

	public override void Place(HouseBuilderContext context, StructureMap structures)
	{
		base.Place(context, structures);
		RainbowifyOnTenthAnniversaryWorlds();
	}
}

                _d59 = true;

                    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(dir))
                    {
                        var slope = new byte[W * H]; var half = new byte[W * H];
                        var lty = new byte[W * H]; var wire = new byte[W * H];
                        for (int x = 0; x < W; x++)
                            for (int y = 0; y < H; y++)
                            {
                                var t = Terraria.Main.tile[x, y];
                                int ii = y * W + x;
                                if (t == null) continue;
                                slope[ii] = (byte)t.slope();
                                half[ii] = t.halfBrick() ? (byte)1 : (byte)0;
                                lty[ii] = (byte)(t.liquid > 0 ? t.liquidType() + 1 : 0);
                                wire[ii] = t.wire() ? (byte)1 : (byte)0;
                            }
                        File.WriteAllBytes(dir + ".slope", slope);
                        File.WriteAllBytes(dir + ".half", half);
                        File.WriteAllBytes(dir + ".lty", lty);
                        File.WriteAllBytes(dir + ".wire", wire);
                        File.AppendAllText(P(), "D59|dumped\n");
                    }
                }
                catch (Exception e) { File.AppendAllText(P(), "D59-ex " + e.GetType().Name + "\n"); }
            }
        }

        }
        public static void ABX(bool ret)
        {
            try { File.AppendAllText(P(), "ABX|" + (ret ? 1 : 0) + "|" + Hash() + "\n"); } catch { }
            ChestProbe3.ABOut();
        }

	public class Blotches : GenAction
	{
		private int _minX;

		private int _minY;

		private int _maxX;

		private int _maxY;

		private double _chance;

		public Blotches(int scale = 2, double chance = 0.3)
		{
			_minX = scale;
			_minY = scale;
			_maxX = scale;
			_maxY = scale;
			_chance = chance;
		}

		public Blotches(int xScale, int yScale, double chance = 0.3)
		{
			_minX = xScale;
			_maxX = xScale;
			_minY = yScale;
			_maxY = yScale;
			_chance = chance;
		}

		public Blotches(int leftScale, int upScale, int rightScale, int downScale, double chance = 0.3)
		{
			_minX = leftScale;
			_maxX = rightScale;
			_minY = upScale;
			_maxY = downScale;
			_chance = chance;
		}

		public override bool Apply(Point origin, int x, int y, params object[] args)
		{
			GenBase._random.NextDouble();
			if (GenBase._random.NextDouble() < _chance)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				int num = GenBase._random.Next(1 - _minX, 1);
				int num2 = GenBase._random.Next(0, _maxX);
				int num3 = GenBase._random.Next(1 - _minY, 1);
				int num4 = GenBase._random.Next(0, _maxY);
				for (int i = num; i <= num2; i++)
				{
					for (int j = num3; j <= num4; j++)
					{
						flag |= !UnitApply(origin, x + i, y + j, args);
					}
				}
				return !flag;
			}
			return UnitApply(origin, x, y, args);
		}
	}
