```
	public class SetTile : GenAction
	{
		private ushort _type;

		private bool _doFraming;

		private bool _doNeighborFraming;

		private bool _clearTile;

		public SetTile(ushort type, bool setSelfFrames = false, bool setNeighborFrames = true, bool clearTile = true)
		{
			_type = type;
			_doFraming = setSelfFrames;
			_doNeighborFraming = setNeighborFrames;
			_clearTile = clearTile;
		}

		public override bool Apply(Point origin, int x, int y, params object[] args)
		{
			Tile tile = GenBase._tiles[x, y];
			if (_clearTile)
			{
				tile.Clear(~(TileDataType.Wiring | TileDataType.Actuator));
			}
			tile.type = _type;
			tile.active(active: true);
			if (_doFraming)
			{
				WorldUtils.TileFrame(x, y, _doNeighborFraming);
			}
			return UnitApply(origin, x, y, args);
		}
	}

	public class SetWall : GenAction
	{
		private ushort _type;

		private bool _doFraming;

		private bool _doNeighborFraming;

		private bool _clearTile;

		public SetWall(ushort type, bool setSelfFrames = false, bool setNeighborFrames = true, bool clearTile = true)
		{

// ── UnifiedRandom（Terraria.Utilities/UnifiedRandom.cs 1:1）─────────────────
// .NET System.Random 的 Knuth 减法生成器（MSEED=161803398），纯 int32 运算。
// 位级移植要点（JS/C# 数值差异全部钉死，改动前先读）：
//  1. C# int 溢出 unchecked 回绕 ↔ JS：本实现所有中间值都落在 int32 范围内
//     （diff 最小 -(2^31-1)，`+((n>>31)&0x7FFFFFFF)` 归位后 ∈[0,2^31-1]），
//     无需模拟回绕；存储用 Int32Array 与 C# int[] 同构。
//  2. `(int)double` 是向零截断 ↔ JS Math.trunc（Sample()≥0 时与 floor 等价，
//     但必须写 trunc 以防有人把 internalSample 改出负值）。
//  3. `Sample()` 常数 4.656612875245797E-10 = 1/(2^31-1)，十进制字面量两语言
//     解析为同一 double，乘法 IEEE754 位级一致。
//  4. `Next(min,max)` 的 range 用 long（≤2^32）↔ JS number 精确整数，安全。
//     大 range 分支的 `(int)(long+min)` unchecked 回绕 ↔ JS `|0`（ToInt32 mod 2^32）。
//  5. `GetSampleForLargeRange` 的 `% 2 == 0`：C# 余数带符号但只判零，JS `%` 同判。
//  金标：tests/golden/unified-random.json 由真·Terraria.exe 反射导出
//  （tools/golden/rand-golden.cs），tests/unified-random.test.ts 位级断言。
//
// ── 种子解析（WorldFileData.TranslateSeed, cs:399-410 1:1）────────────────
// 数字字符串 → Math.Abs(int)（int.MinValue→int.MaxValue）；非数字 →
// ReLogic.Utilities.Crc32.Calculate（IEEE 表，按 UTF-16 code unit 逐字符，
// 注意 `(crc ^ c) & 0xFF` 只取 char 低字节）。Crc32 结果可为负，直接作种子。
export class UnifiedRandom {
  private seedArray: Int32Array;
  private inext = 0;

  constructor(seed: number) {
    this.seedArray = new Int32Array(56);
    this.setSeed(seed);
  }

  /** C# SetSeed（UnifiedRandom.cs:25-61）1:1 */
  setSeed(seed: number): void {
    this.seedArray.fill(0);
    // C#: (Seed == int.MinValue) ? int.MaxValue : Math.Abs(Seed)
    const num = seed === -2147483648 ? 2147483647 : Math.abs(seed);
    let num2 = 161803398 - num;
    this.seedArray[55] = num2;
    let num3 = 1;
    for (let j = 1; j < 55; j++) {
      const num4 = (21 * j) % 55;
      this.seedArray[num4] = num3;
      num3 = (num2 - num3) | 0; // C# unchecked int：可能回绕，|0 = ToInt32 同语义
      if (num3 < 0) num3 += 2147483647; // C# += int.MaxValue（不是 2^32！）
      num2 = this.seedArray[num4];
    }
    for (let k = 1; k < 5; k++) {
      for (let l = 1; l < 56; l++) {
        this.seedArray[l] -= this.seedArray[1 + ((l + 30) % 55)];
        if (this.seedArray[l] < 0) this.seedArray[l] += 2147483647;
      }
    }
    this.inext = 0;
  }

  /** C# Sample（:63-65）*/
  private sample(): number {
    return this.internalSample() * 4.656612875245797e-10;
  }

using Microsoft.Xna.Framework;

namespace Terraria.WorldBuilding;

public abstract class GenAction : GenBase
{
	public GenAction NextAction;

	public ShapeData OutputData;

	private bool _returnFalseOnFailure = true;

	public abstract bool Apply(Point origin, int x, int y, params object[] args);

	protected bool UnitApply(Point origin, int x, int y, params object[] args)
	{
		if (OutputData != null)
		{
			OutputData.Add(x - origin.X, y - origin.Y);
		}
		if (NextAction != null)
		{
			return NextAction.Apply(origin, x, y, args);
		}
		return true;
	}

	public GenAction IgnoreFailures()
	{
		_returnFalseOnFailure = false;
		return this;
	}

	protected bool Fail()
	{
		return !_returnFalseOnFailure;
	}

	public GenAction Output(ShapeData data)
	{
		OutputData = data;
		return this;
	}
}

```

#!/bin/zsh
# x86 基线矩阵补全(串行;专用 7794;只 kill 本端口/本 PID;单次 sleep ≤120s 分段)
# 用法: gen86.sh <queue.tsv>   队列行: name<TAB>size<TAB>seed<TAB>minwait<TAB>evil(空=自然)
# 产出: /tmp/vserver86/<name>.wld + log_<name>.txt + gen86_status.tsv
set -u
V86=/tmp/vserver86
STEAM="$HOME/Library/Application Support/Steam/steamapps/common/Terraria/Terraria.app/Contents/MacOS"
EVILSRV=/tmp/vserver/evil_srv/Terraria.app/Contents/MacOS
EVILHOME=/tmp/vserver/evil_home
STATUS="$V86/gen86_status.tsv"
QUEUE="$1"
touch "$STATUS"

nsleep() {  # 分段 sleep,单段 ≤120s
  local total=$1 left=$1 chunk
  while (( left > 0 )); do
    chunk=$(( left > 120 ? 120 : left ))
    sleep $chunk
    left=$(( left - chunk ))
  done
}

guard() {  # 仅清 7794 端口残留,绝不触碰其他端口
  local lp
  lp=$(pgrep -f 'TerrariaServer.*-port 7794')
  if [ -n "${lp}" ]; then
    print "[$(date +%H:%M:%S)] GUARD: leftover 7794 pid=$lp -> kill"
    /bin/kill -9 ${lp} 2>/dev/null
    sleep 3
  fi

public static class DgTileFrameProbe
{
    private static string H()
    {
        object r = Terraria.Main.rand;
        if (r == null) return "norand";
        var t = r.GetType();
        var sa = (int[])t.GetField("SeedArray", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance).GetValue(r);
        uint ix = (uint)t.GetField("inext", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance).GetValue(r);
        uint h = 2166136261u;
        for (int k = 0; k < sa.Length; k++)
        {
            int v = sa[k];
            h = (h ^ (uint)(v & 0xFF)) * 16777619u;
            h = (h ^ (uint)((v >> 8) & 0xFF)) * 16777619u;
            h = (h ^ (uint)((v >> 16) & 0xFF)) * 16777619u;
            h = (h ^ (uint)((v >> 24) & 0xFF)) * 16777619u;
        }
        h = (h ^ (ix & 0xFF)) * 16777619u;
        h = (h ^ (uint)((ix >> 8) & 0xFF)) * 16777619u;
        h = (h ^ (uint)((ix >> 16) & 0xFF)) * 16777619u;
        h = (h ^ (uint)((ix >> 24) & 0xFF)) * 16777619u;
        return h.ToString("x8");
    }
    public static void Mark(int i, int j)

            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(p)) p = "/tmp/dgu/home/dgtileframe_default.txt";
            System.IO.File.AppendAllText(p, "F|" + i + "|" + j + "|" + H() + "\n");
        }
        catch { }
    }
}

// UR(9293480) 流指纹反解：找 N 使 reseed(seed)+N 掷后的 FNV(SeedArray+inext)
// 等于 passchain_x86.txt 的 pass 尾哈希 → 得各 pass 原版精确掷数。
const SEED = 9293480;
const TARGETS = {
  58: 0x135b4d80, 59: 0x32042896, 60: 0xbdbaa0d3, 61: 0xf4b97083,
  62: 0x1e37b312, 63: 0xdf78094c,
};

function makeRng(seed) {
  const sa = new Int32Array(56);
  // setSeed 1:1
  let num2 = (161803398 - Math.abs(seed)) | 0;
  sa[55] = num2;
  let num3 = 1;
  for (let j = 1; j < 55; j++) {
    const num4 = (21 * j) % 55;
    sa[num4] = num3;
    num3 = (num2 - num3) | 0;
    if (num3 < 0) num3 += 2147483647;
    num2 = sa[num4];
  }
  for (let k = 1; k < 5; k++) {
    for (let l = 1; l < 56; l++) {
      sa[l] = (sa[l] - sa[1 + ((l + 30) % 55)]) | 0;
      if (sa[l] < 0) sa[l] = (sa[l] + 2147483647) | 0;
    }
  }
  let inext = 0;
  const draw = () => {
    let num = inext + 1;
    if (num > 55) num = 1;
    let num22 = num + 21;
    if (num22 > 55) num22 -= 55;
    let num3 = (sa[num] - sa[num22]) | 0;
    if (num3 === 2147483647) num3--;
    num3 = (num3 + ((num3 >> 31) & 0x7fffffff)) | 0;
    sa[num] = num3;
    inext = num;
    return num3;
  };

 "old_string": "function placeDoors(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, rooms: Rect[], def: ThemeDef): void {\n  for (const r of rooms) {\n    // 墙列矩形 (X, Y+1, 1, H-2)\n    // 门禁（原版 PlaceTile(x, exitY)→PlaceDoor(j+1)，WorldGen.cs:31946）：mount\n    // （exitY-1 实心）+ 地板（exitY+3 实心）缺一即不放门只留门洞——HouseBuilder\n    // 的 forced=true 仅绕过首道空格门，门分支的锚点条件仍生效\n    const tryDoor = (x: number, exitY: number) => {\n      for (let dy = 0; dy < 3; dy++) st.setTileSilent(x, exitY + dy, 0);\n      // PlaceTile case10（cs:59867-59906，forced=true 仅过首道空格门）：分支 A\n      // （exitY-1/-2 空 + exitY-3 实心）→ PlaceDoor(i,j-1) 门落 (exitY-2..exitY)；\n      // 分支 B（exitY+1/+2 空 + exitY+3 实心）→ 门落 (exitY..exitY+2)；双败→无门零掷\n      const solidAtV = (yy: number) => st.inBounds(x, yy) && !!st.flags[st.idx(x, yy)] && vanGenSolidType(st.type[st.idx(x, yy)]);\n      const inactiveAt = (yy: number) => st.inBounds(x, yy) && st.flags[st.idx(x, yy)] === 0;\n      if (inactiveAt(exitY - 1) && inactiveAt(exitY - 2) && solidAtV(exitY - 3)) {\n        // PlaceDoor（cs:31938-31960）：三格门框 frameX 各独立掷 Next(3)——每门 3 掷\n        // （N 批 HellFort 同源；house3 vanilla DO→PL=6 掷=双门×3 实锤）\n        rng.int(0, 2); rng.int(0, 2); rng.int(0, 2);\n        placeDoorClosed(st, x, exitY - 2, def.door);\n      } else if (inactiveAt(exitY + 1) && inactiveAt(exitY + 2) && solidAtV(exitY + 3)) {\n        rng.int(0, 2); rng.int(0, 2); rng.int(0, 2);\n        placeDoorClosed(st, x, exitY, def.door);\n      }\n    };\n    // 右侧扫描起点 = room.X+W（墙体列外一格,HouseBuilder.cs:562 wall=(X+W,Y+1,1,H-2)）\n    // ——曾误用墙体列 X+W-1 → 扫描窗含恒实心墙列,门外洞穴 4×3 极易命中 → 门滥发\n    // （house1 vanilla 无门 vs JS 误门 (2045,352) 实锤）\n    const exitR = findSideExit(st, r.x + r.w, r.y + 1, r.h - 2, false);\n    if (exitR !== null) tryDoor(r.x + r.w - 1, exitR);\n    const exitL = findSideExit(st, r.x, r.y + 1, r.h - 2, true);\n    if (exitL !== null) tryDoor(r.x, exitL);\n  }\n}",
 "new_string": "function placeDoors(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, rooms: Rect[], def: ThemeDef): void {\n  for (const r of rooms) {\n    // 墙列矩形 (X, Y+1, 1, H-2)\n    // ★DDDD 逐谓词重对齐（WorldGen.PlaceTile case10 cs:59867-59906 + PlaceDoor\n    //   cs:31938-31960，x86 事件流+门格对拍实锤）：\n    //   ①清洞 = WorldUtils.ClearTile×3（tile.ClearTile()=active/slope/half 清零，\n    //     type/wall/liquid 保留——曾 setTileSilent(0) 连 type 清掉，PlaceChest 双腿\n    //     巨石门读 type 不读 act 会误判）。\n    //   ②PlaceTile 分支 A（j-1/-2 空 + j-3 active+tileSolid）→ PlaceDoor(i,j-1)：\n    //     内部再查 mount(j-3) + SolidTile(i,j+1)——j+1 恰为刚清的门洞格恒非实心\n    //     ⇒ 分支 A 在本语境【必败：零掷零写】（曾按 A 放门+耗 3 掷=幻影门主源）。\n    //   ③分支 B（j+1/+2 空 + j+3 active+tileSolid）→ PlaceDoor(i,j+1)：mount =\n    //     (j-1).nactive && tileSolid[type]（墙上格，仅表查不含半砖/坡）+ 地板 =\n    //     SolidTile(j+3)（含 !tileSolidTop/!half/slope==0）——任一败 → 零掷零写。\n    //   ④成门：3 格 frameX 各独立 Next(3)（variant 逐行独立——曾弃掷值全写 variant0，\n    //     SSS 批 (3706,699) [18,0]vs[0,0] 帧差实锤）。\n    const tryDoor = (x: number, exitY: number) => {\n      for (let dy = 0; dy < 3; dy++) {\n        if (!st.inBounds(x, exitY + dy)) continue;\n        const i = st.idx(x, exitY + dy);\n        st.flags[i] = 0;                 // Tile.ClearTile()：留 type/wall/liquid\n        st.slope[i] = 0;\n        st.half[i] = 0;\n      }\n      const actAt = (yy: number) => st.inBounds(x, yy) && st.flags[st.idx(x, yy)] !== 0;\n      const tableSolidAt = (yy: number) => {   // Main.tileSolid[type]（生成期翻转表）\n        if (!st.inBounds(x, yy)) return false;\n        return vanGenSolidType(st.type[st.idx(x, yy)]);\n      };\n      const solidTileAt = (yy: number) => {    // WorldGen.SolidTile（cs:70155 全谓词）\n        if (!st.inBounds(x, yy)) return false;\n        const i = st.idx(x, yy);\n        if (!st.flags[i]) return false;\n        const t = st.type[i];\n        return vanGenSolidType(t) && !HOUSE_SOLID_TOP.has(TILE_DEFS[t]?.vanilla?.sheet ?? -1)\n          && st.half[i] === 0 && st.slope[i] === 0;\n      };\n      if (!actAt(exitY - 1) && !actAt(exitY - 2) && actAt(exitY - 3) && tableSolidAt(exitY - 3)) {\n        return;                             // 分支 A：PlaceDoor 必败（地板=刚清格），零掷\n      }\n      if (actAt(exitY + 1) || actAt(exitY + 2) || !actAt(exitY + 3) || !tableSolidAt(exitY + 3)) return;\n      if (!(actAt(exitY - 1) && tableSolidAt(exitY - 1))) return;   // PlaceDoor mount\n      if (!solidTileAt(exitY + 3)) return;                          // PlaceDoor floor\n      const v0 = rng.int(0, 2), v1 = rng.int(0, 2), v2 = rng.int(0, 2);\n      placeDoorClosedRows(st, x, exitY, def.door, [v0, v1, v2]);\n    };\n    // 右侧扫描起点 = room.X+W（墙体列外一格,HouseBuilder.cs:562 wall=(X+W,Y+1,1,H-2)）\n    // ——曾误用墙体列 X+W-1 → 扫描窗含恒实心墙列,门外洞穴 4×3 极易命中 → 门滥发\n    // （house1 vanilla 无门 vs JS 误门 (2045,352) 实锤）\n    const exitR = findSideExit(st, r.x + r.w, r.y + 1, r.h - 2, false);\n    if (exitR !== null) tryDoor(r.x + r.w - 1, exitR);\n    const exitL = findSideExit(st, r.x, r.y + 1, r.h - 2, true);\n    if (exitL !== null) tryDoor(r.x, exitL);\n  }\n}"
